---
title: "Match Dashboard"   # set at render time by render_liverpool_dashboards.R
author: "Dr Phil Barter"
format: 
  dashboard:
      scrolling: true
      logo: https://anfieldindex.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/AI-Under-Pressure.png
      nav-buttons: 
                  - icon: github
                    href: https://github.com/Barts78
                  - icon: linkedin
                    href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/phil-barter-55500122/
                  - icon: twitter
                    href: https://twitter.com/Barts78
                  - icon: bluesky
                    href: https://bsky.app/profile/barts78.bsky.social
                    
      theme: 
        - Lux
        - Matchdash_UP_v2.scss
      type: default
      output-dir: docs 
      include-in-header:
        text: |
          <style>
          /* Methodology page: white card bodies (titles keep the theme's green bar) */
          .method-card .card-body {
            background-color: #FFFFFF !important; color: #1A1A1A !important; }
          .method-card .card-body p, .method-card .card-body li,
          .method-card .card-body strong, .method-card .card-body code {
            color: #1A1A1A !important; }
          </style>
params:
  home: "Liverpool"
  away: "Brighton"
  date: "25-10-2026"          # must match the date in the processed file names
  comp: "EPL"                  # folder prefix: "CL" -> "CL Games", "CL Players"
  comp_name: "Premier League"
  season: "2627"
  database: ""                # "" = worked out from comp + season
  focus_team: "Liverpool"     # team the season database is built around
  hmom: ""                    # man of the match (home), "" = hide card
  amom: ""                    # man of the match (away), "" = hide card
---

``` {r}
#set colours from the match data (teamColor / teamTextColor come with the
#shot data, so they sit on each team's shot rows)
team_colour_from_data <- function(team, col) {
  if (!col %in% names(plottingData)) return(NA_character_)
  v <- plottingData[[col]][plottingData$TeamName == team]
  v <- trimws(as.character(v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(v)))]))
  if (length(v)) names(sort(table(v), decreasing = TRUE))[1] else NA_character_
}
# readable text colour for a background if the data has none
contrast_text <- function(bg) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(bg)[, 1] / 255
  if (sum(rgb * c(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)) > 0.6) "black" else "white"
}
Color_Home      <- coalesce(team_colour_from_data(Match_Home, "teamColor"), "#8B1A1A")
Color_Away      <- coalesce(team_colour_from_data(Match_Away, "teamColor"), "royalblue")
Color_Home_Text <- coalesce(team_colour_from_data(Match_Home, "teamTextColor"), contrast_text(Color_Home))
Color_Away_Text <- coalesce(team_colour_from_data(Match_Away, "teamTextColor"), contrast_text(Color_Away))
message("Colours - ", Match_Home, ": ", Color_Home, " / ", Color_Home_Text,

db_dir <- path.expand("~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Data Sets/WhoScored/Databases")

read_season_db <- function(name, comp_filter = NULL) {
  pq <- file.path(db_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet"))
  xl <- file.path(db_dir, paste0(name, ".xlsx"))
  if (requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE) && file.exists(pq)) {
    ds <- arrow::open_dataset(pq)
    if (!is.null(comp_filter)) ds <- ds %>% filter(Competition == comp_filter)
    games <- ds %>% filter(TeamName == Focus_Team) %>% distinct(game_name) %>% collect() %>% pull(game_name)
    return(ds %>% filter(game_name %in% games) %>% collect())   # only these rows are read
  }
  if (file.exists(xl)) {
    d <- read_xlsx(xl)
    if (!is.null(comp_filter)) d <- d %>% filter(Competition == comp_filter)
    return(d %>% group_by(game_name) %>% filter(any(TeamName == Focus_Team)) %>% ungroup())
  }
  NULL
}

build_palette <- function(players,
                          team_color,
                          team_text_color = "#FFFFFF",
                          PalType = c("D", "C"),
                          n_c = 256) {
  
  PalType <- toupper(match.arg(PalType))
  players <- unique(players)
  ramp <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(team_text_color, team_color))
  
  if (PalType == "C") {
    # Continuous: return an actual palette vector (for gradient scales)
    return(ramp(n_c))
  }
  
  # Discrete: named vector (player -> colour)
  n <- length(players)
  if (n == 0) return(setNames(character(0), character(0)))
  if (n == 1) return(setNames(team_color, players))
  
  cols <- ramp(n)
  names(cols) <- players
  cols
}

social_caption <- function(twitter="@Barts78",
                           github = "Barts78",
                           linkedin= "Phil-barter",
                           mastodon= "@DrBarts",
                           threads = "Barts78",
                           data = "OPTA",
                           blueSky = "@barts78",
                           icon_color="black",
                           font_color="#454545",
                           bg_color="snow",
                           font_family="sans-serif"){
  
  icons = list(
    twitter = "&#xe61a",
    github = "&#xf09b",
    linkedin = "&#xf08c",
    mastodon = "&#xf4f6",
    threads = "&#xe618",
    data = "&#xf16b",
    blueSky = "&#xe671"
  )   
  
  social = list(threads = threads, linkedin = linkedin, twitter = twitter, mastodon = mastodon, github = github, blueSky = blueSky, data = data)
  social = social[!is.na(social)]
  
  caption = ""
  for (name in names(social)) {
    icon = icons[name]
    info = social[name]
    html = glue("<span style='font-family:\"Font Awesome 7 Brands\";color:{icon_color};font-size:6px;'>{icon};</span>
                <span style='color:{bg_color};font-size:6px;'>.</span>
                <span style='font-family:{font_family};color:{font_color};font-size:6px;'>{info}</span>
                <span style='color:{bg_color};font-size:6px;'>.</span>")
    
    
    caption = paste0(caption,html)
  }
  
  caption
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# period_selector(): show several versions of a plot (e.g. 1st half,
# 2nd half, to 1st sub) in ONE card with buttons to switch between them.
# Each ggplot is rendered to a PNG once at build time and embedded, so it
# works with every existing plot (density layers, hulls, ggtext etc.).
#   plots      named list of ggplots - names become the button labels
#   id         unique id for this selector (letters, numbers, dashes)
#   color      button colour (team colour); text_color for active label
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared plot helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# theme_ai(): the snow-background theme used across the dashboard.
#   title_size / subtitle_size  text sizes
#   axis = TRUE                 also style axis text and titles
theme_ai <- function(title_size = 8, subtitle_size = 6, axis = FALSE, axis_size = 6,
                     legend_position = "none") {
  t <- theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
             plot.caption = element_markdown(),
             panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
             plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = title_size),
             plot.title.position = "plot",
             plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = subtitle_size),
             legend.position = legend_position)
  if (axis) {
    t <- t + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = axis_size),
                   axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = axis_size, face = "bold"))
  }
  t
}

# pitch_base(): Opta pitch + dashed zone lines (thirds/channels, Zone 14,
# half-spaces) + optional 14 / LHS / RHS labels. Add it like any layer:
#   ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) + pitch_base(labels = TRUE) + geom_point()
pitch_base <- function(fill = "#DBDBDB", line_col = "#454545", zone_lwd = 0.3,
                       zone_col = "#95A5A6", labels = FALSE, label_size = 2,
                       tile = FALSE) {
  list(
    annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = fill, colour = line_col),
    theme_pitch(),
    if (tile) geom_tile(),
    annotate("segment", y = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9), yend = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9),
             x = 0, xend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = zone_lwd, colour = zone_col),
    annotate("segment", x = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83), xend = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83),
             y = 0, yend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = zone_lwd, colour = zone_col),
    # geom_text with its own small data frame (not annotate) so the labels
    # also work on faceted plots - annotate() with vector labels errors there
    if (labels) geom_text(data = data.frame(x = 74.7, y = c(50, 71.05, 28.95),
                                            label = c("14", "LHS", "RHS")),
                          aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                          size = label_size, colour = "grey")
  )
}
period_selector <- function(plots, id, color = "#454545", text_color = "white",
                            width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150) {
  plots <- plots[!vapply(plots, is.null, logical(1))]
  imgs <- lapply(seq_along(plots), function(i) {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    # warnings/messages from rendering would become extra chunk outputs and
    # knock the card title off, so keep them quiet
    suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
      ggsave(f, plots[[i]], width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "snow")))
    htmltools::tags$img(src = knitr::image_uri(f), class = "ps-img",
                        `data-idx` = i, alt = names(plots)[i],
                        style = if (i > 1) "display:none;" else NULL)
  })
  btns <- lapply(seq_along(plots), function(i) {
    htmltools::tags$button(names(plots)[i], type = "button", `data-idx` = i,
                           class = if (i == 1) "ps-btn active" else "ps-btn")
  })
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML(
      ".period-selector .ps-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
       .period-selector .ps-btn{border:1px solid var(--ps-col);background:#fff;color:var(--ps-col);
         border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .8rem;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer}
       .period-selector .ps-btn.active{background:var(--ps-col);color:var(--ps-txt);font-weight:600}
       .period-selector .ps-img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}")),
    htmltools::div(
      id = id, class = "period-selector",
      style = paste0("--ps-col:", color, ";--ps-txt:", text_color, ";"),
      htmltools::div(class = "ps-btns", btns),
      htmltools::div(class = "ps-imgs", imgs),
      htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
        "(function(){var r=document.getElementById('%s');if(!r)return;
          r.querySelectorAll('.ps-btn').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){
            var i=b.getAttribute('data-idx');
            r.querySelectorAll('.ps-btn').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('active',x===b);});
            r.querySelectorAll('.ps-img').forEach(function(m){m.style.display=(m.getAttribute('data-idx')===i)?'':'none';});
          });});})();", id)))
    )
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Interactive player tables (reactable). Sticky player names, rows
# grouped by position (group header shows totals / averages), search
# and sorting. Set use_interactive_tables <- FALSE to go back to the gt
# tables everywhere - the gt code is untouched.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
use_interactive_tables <- TRUE
min_touches_pc <- 20   # Poss Control /100 Touches is greyed out below this many touches
table_header_size <- "0.67rem"   # column title font size in the player tables

ai_reactable <- function(data, color, text_color, subtitle = NULL,
                         group = "Position", sticky = "Name", grey_below = NULL) {
  role_levels <- c("Keeper", "Defender", "Midfielder", "Forward")
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("Team")) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(dplyr::any_of(c(group, sticky)))
  if (group %in% names(data)) {
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::arrange(factor(.data[[group]], levels = role_levels),
                     dplyr::desc(if ("Mins" %in% names(data)) Mins else 0))
  }
  is_pct  <- function(n) grepl("%|Success( |$)|Suc$|Accuracy|Quality|^EPV Won$|^EPV Lost$", n)
  is_rate <- function(n) grepl("/", n)
  shade <- function(value) {
    if (is.na(value)) return(NULL)
    a <- max(0, min(1, value))
    list(background = grDevices::adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = 0.10 + 0.65 * a),
         color = if (a > 0.65) text_color else "black")
  }
  cols <- list()
  for (n in names(data)[vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1))]) {
    if (is_pct(n)) {
      cols[[n]] <- reactable::colDef(format = reactable::colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 0),
                                     aggregate = "mean", style = shade, minWidth = 85)
    } else {
      whole <- all(abs(data[[n]] - round(data[[n]])) < 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE)
      agg <- if (n == "Mins") "max" else if (is_rate(n)) "mean" else "sum"
      cols[[n]] <- reactable::colDef(format = reactable::colFormat(digits = if (whole) 0 else 2),
                                     aggregate = agg, minWidth = 70)
    }
  }
  cols[[sticky]] <- reactable::colDef(sticky = "left", minWidth = 160,
                                      style = list(fontWeight = 600, background = "#F2F2F2"))
  if (group %in% names(data)) {
    cols[[group]] <- reactable::colDef(name = "", sticky = "left", minWidth = 120,
                                       style = list(background = "#F2F2F2"))
  }
  # Possession control per 100 touches: grey the cell for low-touch players
  low_touch_note <- NULL
  if ("Low_Touches" %in% names(data)) {
    low <- as.logical(data$Low_Touches)
    cols[["Low_Touches"]] <- reactable::colDef(show = FALSE)
    pc <- "Poss Control /100 Touches"
    if (pc %in% names(data)) {
      cols[[pc]] <- reactable::colDef(
        format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 1), aggregate = "mean", minWidth = 85,
        style = function(value, index) {
          if (isTRUE(low[index])) list(color = "#9E9E9E", fontStyle = "italic", background = "#F2F2F2")
        })
      low_touch_note <- paste0("Greyed Poss Control /100 Touches = fewer than ", min_touches_pc, " touches.")
    }
  }
  row_style <- if (!is.null(grey_below) && "Mins" %in% names(data)) {
    function(index) if (!is.na(data$Mins[index]) && data$Mins[index] < grey_below)
      list(color = "#9E9E9E", fontStyle = "italic")
  } else NULL

  rt <- reactable::reactable(
    data,
    groupBy = if (group %in% names(data)) group else NULL,
    defaultExpanded = TRUE, columns = cols, rowStyle = row_style,
    searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE, pagination = FALSE,
    compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, striped = TRUE, fullWidth = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = reactable::colDef(align = "right",
                                      headerStyle = list(background = "#DBDBDB", fontSize = table_header_size)),
    theme = reactable::reactableTheme(
      style = list(fontSize = "0.8rem", backgroundColor = "snow"),
      groupHeaderStyle = list(background = color, color = text_color),
      searchInputStyle = list(width = "16rem"))
  )
  # attach subtitle / caption to the widget itself so the chunk has ONE
  # output - multiple outputs split a dashboard card into untitled tabs
  if (!is.null(subtitle)) {
    rt <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(
      rt, htmltools::div(subtitle, style = "font-size:0.8rem;color:#555;margin-bottom:0.3rem;"))
  }
  htmlwidgets::appendContent(
    rt, htmltools::div(paste(c(low_touch_note, gt_caption), collapse = " | "),
                       style = "font-size:0.7rem;color:#777;margin-top:0.3rem;"))
}

show_player_table <- function(gt_tbl, data, color, text_color, subtitle = NULL, grey_below = NULL) {
  if (!use_interactive_tables || !requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)) {
    # gt fallback: grey the per-100-touches cell for low-touch players, hide the flag
    if ("Low_Touches" %in% names(gt_tbl[["_data"]])) {
      low_rows <- which(as.logical(gt_tbl[["_data"]]$Low_Touches))
      if ("Poss Control /100 Touches" %in% names(gt_tbl[["_data"]]) && length(low_rows)) {
        gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% tab_style(
          style = list(cell_text(color = "#9E9E9E", style = "italic"), cell_fill(color = "#F2F2F2")),
          locations = cells_body(columns = "Poss Control /100 Touches", rows = low_rows))
      }
      gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>% cols_hide(columns = "Low_Touches")
    }
    return(gt_tbl)
  }
  ai_reactable(data, color, text_color, subtitle = subtitle, grey_below = grey_below)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: Simulate Football Match Outcomes Based on xG
#'
#' @param home_xg_vector Numeric vector of xG values for each home team shot
#' @param away_xg_vector Numeric vector of xG values for each away team shot
#' @param runs Number of simulations to perform (default: 10000)
#' @param seed Random seed for reproducibility (default: 1111)
#'
#' @return A list containing:
#' - `prob_matrix`: A matrix of scoreline probabilities
#' - `long_prob_matrix`: Data frame for plotting with ggplot
#' - `simulation_results`: Data frame of simulated outcomes


simulate_match_outcomes <- function(
  home_xg_vector = NULL,
  away_xg_vector = NULL,
  home_data = NULL,
  away_data = NULL,
  home_xg_var = "xG",
  away_xg_var = "xG",
  home_xgot_vector = NULL,
  away_xgot_vector = NULL,
  home_xgot_var = NULL,
  away_xgot_var = NULL,
  runs = 10000,
  seed = 1111,
  actual_home_goals = NULL,
  actual_away_goals = NULL,
  method = "xg",
  xgot_weight = 0.5
) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Pull columns from data if provided
  if (!is.null(home_data)) {
    home_xg_vector <- home_data[[home_xg_var]]
    if (!is.null(home_xgot_var) && home_xgot_var %in% names(home_data)) {
      home_xgot_vector <- home_data[[home_xgot_var]]
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(away_data)) {
    away_xg_vector <- away_data[[away_xg_var]]
    if (!is.null(away_xgot_var) && away_xgot_var %in% names(away_data)) {
      away_xgot_vector <- away_data[[away_xgot_var]]
    }
  }
  
  safe_simulate_goals <- function(xg_vector, xgot_vector = NULL, runs,
                                  method = "xg", xgot_weight = 0.5) {
    
    # EXACT old xG behaviour
    if (method == "xg") {
      xg_vector <- unlist(xg_vector)
      
      if (length(xg_vector) == 0) return(rep(0, runs))
      
      xg_vector <- as.numeric(xg_vector)
      xg_vector <- xg_vector[!is.na(xg_vector)]
      xg_vector <- pmin(pmax(xg_vector, 0), 1)
      
      if (length(xg_vector) == 0) return(rep(0, runs))
      
      draws <- rbinom(length(xg_vector) * runs, size = 1, prob = rep(xg_vector, each = runs))
      goals_matrix <- matrix(draws, nrow = runs, byrow = FALSE)
      return(rowSums(goals_matrix))
    }
    
    # For xGOT/blend methods, align shots row-wise
    xg_vector <- unlist(xg_vector)
    xgot_vector <- unlist(xgot_vector)
    
    n <- max(length(xg_vector), length(xgot_vector))
    
    shot_df <- data.frame(
      xg   = as.numeric(c(xg_vector, rep(NA_real_, n - length(xg_vector)))),
      xgot = as.numeric(c(xgot_vector, rep(NA_real_, n - length(xgot_vector))))
    )
    
    shot_df <- shot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        xg   = pmin(pmax(xg, 0), 1),
        xgot = pmin(pmax(xgot, 0), 1)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(xg))
    
    if (nrow(shot_df) == 0) return(rep(0, runs))
    
    if (method == "xgot") {
      shot_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(shot_df$xgot), shot_df$xgot, shot_df$xg)
      
    } else if (method == "blend") {
      shot_prob <- ifelse(
        !is.na(shot_df$xgot),
        (1 - xgot_weight) * shot_df$xg + xgot_weight * shot_df$xgot,
        shot_df$xg
      )
      
    } else if (method == "max") {
      shot_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(shot_df$xgot),
                          pmax(shot_df$xg, shot_df$xgot),
                          shot_df$xg)
      
    } else if (method == "min") {
      shot_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(shot_df$xgot),
                          pmin(shot_df$xg, shot_df$xgot),
                          shot_df$xg)
      
    } else {
      stop("Invalid method. Choose from 'xg', 'xgot', 'blend', 'max', 'min'")
    }
    
    shot_prob <- pmin(pmax(shot_prob, 0), 1)
    
    draws <- rbinom(length(shot_prob) * runs, size = 1, prob = rep(shot_prob, each = runs))
    goals_matrix <- matrix(draws, nrow = runs, byrow = FALSE)
    rowSums(goals_matrix)
  }
  
  home_goals <- safe_simulate_goals(
    xg_vector = home_xg_vector,
    xgot_vector = home_xgot_vector,
    runs = runs,
    method = method,
    xgot_weight = xgot_weight
  )
  
  away_goals <- safe_simulate_goals(
    xg_vector = away_xg_vector,
    xgot_vector = away_xgot_vector,
    runs = runs,
    method = method,
    xgot_weight = xgot_weight
  )
  
  simulation_results <- data.frame(Home = home_goals, Away = away_goals)
  prob_matrix <- table(simulation_results$Home, simulation_results$Away) / runs
  
  long_prob_matrix <- as.data.frame(as.table(prob_matrix))
  colnames(long_prob_matrix) <- c("Home", "Away", "Probability")
  long_prob_matrix <- long_prob_matrix %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Probability = round(Probability * 100, 2))
  
  goal_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(actual_home_goals) && !is.null(actual_away_goals)) {
    exact_count <- sum(home_goals == actual_home_goals & away_goals == actual_away_goals)
    at_least_home <- sum(home_goals >= actual_home_goals)
    at_least_away <- sum(away_goals >= actual_away_goals)
    
    goal_summary <- list(
      actual_score = paste(actual_home_goals, "-", actual_away_goals),
      exact_occurrences = exact_count,
      exact_percentage = round(100 * exact_count / runs, 2),
      home_goals_at_least = at_least_home,
      away_goals_at_least = at_least_away,
      home_goals_at_least_pct = round(100 * at_least_home / runs, 2),
      away_goals_at_least_pct = round(100 * at_least_away / runs, 2)
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    prob_matrix = prob_matrix,
    long_prob_matrix = long_prob_matrix,
    simulation_results = simulation_results,
    goal_summary = goal_summary
  ))
}
```


```{r}
#| label: Team season sumary function 

# Reusable function to compute team summary metrics
compute_season_summary <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    mutate(Successful_Touch = ifelse(isTouch == "TRUE", 1, 0),
           TeamEPV = ifelse(str_detect(`outcomeType/value`, "1"), EPVvalue, 0),
           TeamEPV = as.numeric(TeamEPV),
           Own_Goals = if ("Own_Goals" %in% names(data)) coalesce(as.numeric(data$Own_Goals), 0) else 0,
           Match_day = as.numeric(Match_day)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(Match_day = first(Match_day),
              n_matches = n_distinct(game_name),
              across(c(Goals, In_play_time, Touches, UnSuccessful_Touches, PK_Box_Touches,
                       Final_Third_Touches, Attacking_Half_Touches, Defensive_Half_Touches,
                       Mis_Control, Dispossessed_Total, Dribbles_Total, Dribbles_Won, Dribbles_Lost,
                       TotalShots, OFShots, Blocked_Shot, OTShots, SixYard_Box_Shots,
                       PK_Box_Shots, Out_Box_Shots, BCs, xG, NPxG, xGOT, 
                       Attempted_Passes,
                       Successful_Passes, 
                       UnSuccessful_Passes, 
                       Long_Passes, 
                       Successful_Long_Passes,
                       Corners, 
                       Short_Corners, 
                       Cross_Passes, 
                       Successful_Cross, 
                       UnSuccessful_Cross,
                       Tackles_Total, 
                       Tackles_Won, 
                       Tackles_Lost, 
                       Fouls_Total, 
                       Fouls_Conceeded,
                       Fouls_Received, 
                       Aerial_Won, 
                       Aerial_Lost,
                       Clearances_Total,
                       Interceptions_Total,
                       Recoverys_Total, 
                       Offside_Won, 
                       Offside_Lost, 
                       TeamEPV, 
                       Own_Goals,
                       Defensive_Third_Touches, 
        Middle_Third_Touches, 
        SixYard_Box_Touches, 
        Attempted_Carries, 
        Successful_Carries, 
        Prog_Carries, 
        Final_Third_Carries,
        Final_Third_Passes, 
        PK_Box_Passes,
        Prog_Passes,
        Key_Passes,
        Assists,
        MyxA,
        TeamxT,
        Aerial_total, 
        Ground_Duels_Total, 
        Ground_Duels_Won, 
        Ground_Duels_Lost,
),
        ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / n_matches
      ),
      #.groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    #select(-n_matches) %>%
    # own goals: the OG row sits with the conceding team, so add the
    # opponent's OGs (other rows in the same group) to this team's Goals
    mutate(Goals = Goals + (sum(Own_Goals) - Own_Goals)) %>%
    select(-Own_Goals) %>%
    mutate(
      In_play_time = round(In_play_time / 60, 1),
      Possession   = round((Touches / (sum(Touches))) * 100, 1),
      Field_Tilt   = round((Final_Third_Touches / (sum(Final_Third_Touches))) * 100, 1),
      Pass_Success = round((Successful_Passes / Attempted_Passes) * 100, 1),
      Long_Pass_Success = round((Successful_Long_Passes / Long_Passes) * 100, 1),
      Long_Pass_Rate    = round((Long_Passes / Attempted_Passes) * 100, 2),
      Cross_Success     = round((Successful_Cross / Cross_Passes) * 100, 2),
      Failed_Pass    = Attempted_Passes - Successful_Passes,
      Failed_Cross   = Cross_Passes - Successful_Cross,
      Failed_Dribble = Dribbles_Total - Dribbles_Won,
      Poss_Gained = Interceptions_Total + Recoverys_Total +
                    (Tackles_Won - Tackles_Lost) + (Aerial_Won - Aerial_Lost),
      Poss_Lost = Mis_Control + UnSuccessful_Passes + UnSuccessful_Cross + Dribbles_Lost +
                  OFShots + Blocked_Shot + Dispossessed_Total + Offside_Lost,
      Posession_Control =
        Interceptions_Total + Recoverys_Total + (Tackles_Won - Tackles_Lost) +
        (Aerial_Won - Aerial_Lost) -
        (Mis_Control + Dispossessed_Total + UnSuccessful_Passes +
         UnSuccessful_Cross + Dribbles_Lost + OFShots + Blocked_Shot + Offside_Lost),
      Poss_Control_100 = round(100 * Posession_Control / Touches, 1),
      `EPV % xG Con.`   = round((xG   / TeamEPV) * 100, 1),
      `EPV % NPxG Con.` = round((NPxG / TeamEPV) * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}
```

```{r}
    mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

``` {r}
#| label: Shift column function
# Shift column funtion, this copies the player name columna into a new column and shifts it up one to then be the reciever 
shift_column <- function(data, columns, new_names = sprintf("%s.Shifted", columns), len = 1L, up = TRUE) {
  if (length(columns) != length(new_names)) {
    stop("columns and new_names must be the same length")
  }
  
  # get the rows to keep based on how much to shift it by and weather to shift up or down
  rowsToKeep <- seq(from = 1 + len * up, length.out = NROW(data) - len)
  
  # for the original data -- it needs to be shifted the other way
  dataRowsToKeep <- seq(from = 1 + len * !up, length.out = NROW(data) - len)
  
  #create a df of the shifted rows
  shiftedDF <- data[rowsToKeep, columns]
  
  # give the right names to these new columns
  names(shiftedDF) <- new_names
  
  # data names
  dataNames <- names(data)
  
  # get rid of excess rows in data
  data <- data[dataRowsToKeep, ]
  
  # tack shifted data onto the end of the original (and cutoff) data
  data <- cbind(data, shiftedDF)
  names(data) <- c(dataNames, new_names)
  
  return(data)
  }
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: touch area function Quantiles
#' Function for plotting Player touch areas
#' Function for plotting Team touch areas - set at 75%

#calculate touch area of player - set at 75% using quantiles
touch_area_shape_quantiles <- function(data) {
  
  x_low <- quantile(data$x, 0.15)
  x_high <- quantile(data$x, 0.85)
  
  y_low <- quantile(data$y, 0.15)
  y_high <- quantile(data$y, 0.85)
  
  touch_area_data <- data %>%  
    filter((x > x_low) & (x < x_high)) %>%
    filter((y > y_low) & (y < y_high)) %>%
    slice(chull(x, y))
  
  return(touch_area_data)
}
```
```{r}

#| output: false
#| label: touch area function Mad
#' Function for plotting Player touch areas using 1.5 MAD( 75% of data) Mediands
touch_area_shape_mad <- function(data) {
  
  x_median <- median(data$x)
  y_median <- median(data$y)
  
  x_mad <- median(abs(data$x - x_median))/0.6745
  y_mad <- median(abs(data$y - y_median))/0.6745
  
  x_low <- x_median - 1.5*x_mad
  x_high <- x_median + 1.5*x_mad
  
  y_low <- y_median - 1.5*y_mad
  y_high <- y_median + 1.5*y_mad
  
  touch_area_data <- data %>%  
    filter((x > x_low) & (x < x_high)) %>%
    filter((y > y_low) & (y < y_high)) %>%
    slice(chull(x, y))
  
  return(touch_area_data)
}
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: Enhanced TouchPlayerPlot_AI with method selection and dynamic faceting
TouchPlayerPlot_AI <- function(
  data,
  color = "firebrick4",
  text_color = "",
  title = "",
  subtitle = "",
  plot_start = 0,
  plot_finish = 110,
  logo = "",
  method = "quantile",  # or "mad"
  facet_by = "playerId"
) {
  required_cols <- c("x", "y", "finalX", "finalY", "playerId", "expandedMinute", "Game_Period", "role")
  if (nrow(data) == 0 || !all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("The dataset has insufficient columns and/or insufficient data.")
  }

  data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Successful_Touches == 1
      #`type/value` %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10:16, 41, 42, 44, 45, 50, 52, 54, 61, 73, 74),
           #`outcomeType/value` == 1
      ) %>%
    drop_na(playerId, x, y) %>%
    filter(between(expandedMinute, plot_start, plot_finish))

  # nothing to draw in this window: return a note instead of a facet error
  empty_note <- function() {
    ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, size = 4,
               label = paste0("Not enough touches between minute ", round(plot_start), " and ", round(plot_finish), " to draw touch areas")) +
      labs(title = paste(title, "Player Touch Areas"), subtitle = subtitle, caption = My_caption) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
            plot.caption = element_markdown())
  }
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return(empty_note())

  list_data <- split(data, data$playerId)

  # Use appropriate shape function
  shape_fn <- if (method == "mad") touch_area_shape_mad else touch_area_shape_quantiles
  touch_area_data <- purrr::map(list_data, shape_fn) %>% purrr::reduce(full_join)

  PlayerPos <- touch_area_data %>%
    group_by(playerId) %>%
    summarise(x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    na.omit()

  teamtitle <- paste(title, "Player Touch Areas")
  
# --- 1) Desired role order ---------------------------------------------------
role_levels <- c("Keeper", "Defender", "Midfielder", "Forward")
facet_col   <- sym(facet_by)

# --- 2) Build facet order: filter by minutes, then sort by role --------------
facet_levels <- data %>%
  group_by(playerId, file_name) %>%
  summarise(match_minutes = max(expandedMinute, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(playerId) %>%
  summarise(total_minutes = sum(match_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # players with 5+ minutes; for a short window (e.g. an early first sub) keep everyone
  { d <- .; if (any(d$total_minutes > 5)) filter(d, total_minutes > 5) else d } %>%
  left_join(
    data %>%
      distinct(playerId, role),
    by = "playerId"
  ) %>%
  mutate(role = factor(role, levels = role_levels)) %>%
  arrange(role, desc(total_minutes), playerId) %>%
  pull(playerId)

# nothing to draw in this window: return a note instead of a facet error
if (length(facet_levels) == 0 || is.null(touch_area_data) || nrow(touch_area_data) == 0) return(empty_note())

# --- 3) Relevel the faceting variable in ALL datasets used in the plot --------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(!!facet_col := factor(.data[[facet_by]], levels = facet_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[facet_by]]))

touch_area_data <- touch_area_data %>%
  mutate(!!facet_col := factor(.data[[facet_by]], levels = facet_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[facet_by]]))

PlayerPos <- PlayerPos %>%
  mutate(!!facet_col := factor(.data[[facet_by]], levels = facet_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[facet_by]]))

  player_touch_map <- ggplot(touch_area_data) +
    pitch_base(labels = TRUE, label_size = 1.5) +
    
    geom_point(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y), alpha = 0.5, colour = "black", size = 1) +
    geom_polygon(aes(x = x, y = y), colour = color, alpha = 0.2, fill = color, size = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = PlayerPos, aes(x = x, y = y), colour = color, alpha = 0.8, shape = 19, size = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_by)), ncol = 5) +
    labs(
      title = teamtitle,
      x = "",
      subtitle = paste(subtitle, "
Area = 75% of activity, Team Colour Dot = Player Average Position"),
      caption = My_caption
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
      panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = color, color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6, colour = text_color),
      plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8),
      plot.caption = element_markdown(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )

  if (logo == "Yes") {
    player_touch_mapAI <- ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(player_touch_map, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, scale = 1) +
      draw_image(logo_AI, x = 0.445, y = 0.438, scale = 0.12)
  } else {
    player_touch_mapAI <- player_touch_map
  }

  return(player_touch_mapAI)
}
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| lable: Enhanced TouchTeamPlot_OPTA with method selection
TouchTeamPlot_OPTA <- function(
  data,
  color = "#E74C3C",
  palette = NULL,
  title = "",
  subtitle = "",
  plot_start = 0,
  plot_finish = 45,
  logo = "",
  method = "mad"  # or "quantile"
) {
  required_cols <- c("x", "y", "finalX", "finalY", "playerId", "expandedMinute", "Game_Period", "file_name", "role")
  if (nrow(data) == 0 || !all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop("The dataset has insufficient columns and/or insufficient data.")
  }

  data <- data %>%
    drop_na(playerId, x, y) %>%
    filter(dplyr::between(expandedMinute, plot_start, plot_finish))

  shape_fn <- if (method == "quantile") touch_area_shape_quantiles else touch_area_shape_mad
  list_data <- split(data, data$playerId)
  touch_area_data <- purrr::map(list_data, shape_fn) %>% purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join)

  PlayerPos <- touch_area_data %>%
    group_by(playerId) %>%
    summarise(x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  # ---- NEW: build palette from `palette` or default white -> color ramp ----
  players <- sort(unique(as.character(touch_area_data$playerId)))
  n <- length(players)

  build_palette <- function(players, palette, color) {
    n <- length(players)

    # 1) Named vector mapping playerId -> color
    if (is.character(palette) && !is.null(names(palette))) {
      if (!all(players %in% names(palette))) {
        warning("Named palette does not cover all players; missing players will be auto-colored.")
      }
      cols <- palette[players]
      # fill any NAs (uncovered players) from a white->color ramp
      if (anyNA(cols)) {
        fill_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", color))(sum(is.na(cols)))
        cols[is.na(cols)] <- fill_cols
      }
      names(cols) <- players
      return(cols)
    }

    # 2) Paletteer "pkg::pal" string
    if (is.character(palette) && length(palette) == 1 && grepl("::", palette, fixed = TRUE)) {
      if (requireNamespace("paletteer", quietly = TRUE)) {
        cols <- as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d(palette, n))
        names(cols) <- players
        return(cols)
      } else {
        warning("paletteer not installed; falling back to white -> color ramp.")
      }
    }

    # 3) Plain vector of colors to interpolate
    if (is.character(palette) && length(palette) >= 1) {
      cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(palette)(n)
      names(cols) <- players
      return(cols)
    }

    # Default: white -> color ramp (keeps your 'min = white' feel)
    cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", color))(n)
    if (n == 1) cols <- color
    names(cols) <- players
    cols
  }

  pal <- build_palette(players, palette, color)

  # lock factor levels
  touch_area_data <- touch_area_data %>%
    mutate(playerId = factor(as.character(playerId), levels = players))
  PlayerPos <- PlayerPos %>%
    mutate(playerId = factor(as.character(playerId), levels = players))
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  teamtitle <- paste(title, "Areas")

  touch_map <- ggplot(touch_area_data) +
    
    # use the palette (discrete by player)
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +

    annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = "#DBDBDB", colour = "#454545") +
    theme_pitch() +
    annotate("segment", y = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9), yend = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9),
             x = 0, xend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
    annotate("segment", x = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83), xend = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83),
             y = 0, yend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
    
    #plot player touch area
    geom_polygon(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = playerId, colour = playerId), alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) +
    #plot player average position
    geom_point(data = PlayerPos, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = playerId, colour = playerId),
               alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
    # plot player name
    geom_text(data = PlayerPos, aes(x = x, y = y + 4, label = playerId, colour = playerId), size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = teamtitle,
      subtitle = paste(subtitle, "\nArea = 75% of activity, Dot = Player Average Position"),
      caption = My_caption,
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#DBDBDB", colour = NA), 
      strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8), 
      plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8),
      plot.caption = element_markdown(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  if (logo == "Yes") {
    touch_mapAI <- ggdraw() +
      draw_plot(touch_map, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, scale = 1) +
      draw_image(logo_AI, x = 0.4, y = 0.45, scale = 0.07)
  } else {
    touch_mapAI <- touch_map
  }

  return(touch_mapAI)
}
```

``` {r}
#| output: false
#| label: Team Press Zone Function

TeamPressPlot_OPTA <- function(
    data,
    color = "#E74C3C",
    palette = NULL,
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    plot_start = 0,
    plot_finish = 45,
    Fail = "",
    CPress = "",
    Turnover = "",
    CAttack = "",
    GPress = "",
    PShot = "",
    DPoss = "",
    logo = "",
    method = "mad"
) {
  
  # ==========================================================
  # VALIDATION
  # ==========================================================
  
  required_cols <- c(
    "x",
    "y",
    "finalX",
    "finalY",
    "Player Name",
    "minute",
    "Game_Period",
    "Action_detail",
    "Counter_Press",
    "Group_Press",
    "Turnover",
    "Counter_Attack",
    "Position",
    "Failed_Press",
    "Led to Goal",
    "Led to Shot",
    "Direct_Possession_Win"
  )
  
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  
  if (nrow(data) == 0 || length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      message(
        "Missing columns: ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    
    stop(
      "The dataset has insufficient columns and/or insufficient data."
    )
  }
  
  method <- match.arg(
    method,
    choices = c("mad", "quantile")
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # FILTER DATA
  # ==========================================================
  
  data <- data %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(
      .data$playerId,
      .data$x,
      .data$y
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      dplyr::between(
        .data$minute,
        plot_start,
        plot_finish
      )
    )
  
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No pressing events were found between plot_start and plot_finish."
    )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SELECT AREA METHOD
  # ==========================================================
  
  shape_fn <- switch(
    method,
    "quantile" = touch_area_shape_quantiles,
    "mad" = touch_area_shape_mad
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # CALCULATE PLAYER PRESS AREAS
  # ==========================================================
  
  list_data <- split(
    data,
    as.character(data$playerId)
  )
  
  press_area_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
    list_data,
    shape_fn
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # CALCULATE PLAYER AVERAGE PRESS POSITION
  # ==========================================================
  
  PlayerPos <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$playerId,
      .data$Position
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      x = median(.data$x, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = median(.data$y, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(
      .data$x,
      .data$y
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # EVENT DATA
  # ==========================================================
  
  FailPress <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Failed_Press == 1)
  
  CounterPress <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press == 1)
  
  GroupPress <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Group_Press == 1)
  
  GroupPressCounter <- GroupPress %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press == 1)
  
  GroupPressNormal <- GroupPress %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press != 1 | is.na(.data$Counter_Press))
  
  TurnOvers <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Turnover == 1)
  
  CounterAttack <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Attack == 1)
  
  CounterAttackCounter <- CounterAttack %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press == 1)
  
  CounterAttackNormal <- CounterAttack %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press != 1 | is.na(.data$Counter_Press))
  
  PLS <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[["Led to Goal"]] == 1 |
        .data[["Led to Shot"]] == 1
    )
  
  PLSCounter <- PLS %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press == 1)
  
  PLSNormal <- PLS %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press != 1 | is.na(.data$Counter_Press))
  
  DPW <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Direct_Possession_Win == 1)
  
  DPWCounter <- DPW %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press == 1)
  
  DPWNormal <- DPW %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Counter_Press != 1 | is.na(.data$Counter_Press))
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # BUILD PLAYER PALETTE
  # ==========================================================
  
  players <- sort(
    unique(as.character(data$playerId))
  )
  
  build_palette <- function(players, palette, color) {
    
    n <- length(players)
    
    # Named vector:
    # c("Player A" = "#FFFFFF", "Player B" = "#FF0000")
    if (
      is.character(palette) &&
      !is.null(names(palette))
    ) {
      
      if (!all(players %in% names(palette))) {
        warning(
          paste(
            "Named palette does not cover every player.",
            "Missing players will be automatically coloured."
          )
        )
      }
      
      cols <- palette[players]
      
      if (anyNA(cols)) {
        
        fill_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
          c("#FFFFFF", color)
        )(sum(is.na(cols)))
        
        cols[is.na(cols)] <- fill_cols
      }
      
      names(cols) <- players
      
      return(cols)
    }
    
    # Paletteer palette, for example:
    # palette = "tvthemes::Regular"
    if (
      is.character(palette) &&
      length(palette) == 1 &&
      grepl("::", palette, fixed = TRUE)
    ) {
      
      if (requireNamespace("paletteer", quietly = TRUE)) {
        
        cols <- as.character(
          paletteer::paletteer_d(
            palette,
            n
          )
        )
        
        names(cols) <- players
        
        return(cols)
        
      } else {
        
        warning(
          paste(
            "The paletteer package is not installed.",
            "Using the default white-to-colour palette."
          )
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Plain vector of colours to interpolate
    if (
      is.character(palette) &&
      length(palette) >= 1
    ) {
      
      cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
        palette
      )(n)
      
      names(cols) <- players
      
      return(cols)
    }
    
    # Default white-to-selected-colour ramp
    cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
      c("#FFFFFF", color)
    )(n)
    
    if (n == 1) {
      cols <- color
    }
    
    names(cols) <- players
    
    cols
  }
  
  pal <- build_palette(
    players = players,
    palette = palette,
    color = color
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # LOCK PLAYER FACTOR LEVELS
  # ==========================================================
  
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      playerId = factor(
        as.character(.data$playerId),
        levels = players
      )
    )
  
  press_area_data <- press_area_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      playerId = factor(
        as.character(.data$playerId),
        levels = players
      )
    )
  
  PlayerPos <- PlayerPos %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      playerId = factor(
        as.character(.data$playerId),
        levels = players
      )
    )
  
  
  # Update factor levels for the event datasets
  event_data <- list(
    FailPress,
    CounterPress,
    GroupPressCounter,
    GroupPressNormal,
    TurnOvers,
    CounterAttackCounter,
    CounterAttackNormal,
    PLSCounter,
    PLSNormal,
    DPWCounter,
    DPWNormal
  )
  
  event_data <- purrr::map(
    event_data,
    ~ .x %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        playerId = factor(
          as.character(.data$playerId),
          levels = players
        )
      )
  )
  
  FailPress <- event_data[[1]]
  CounterPress <- event_data[[2]]
  GroupPressCounter <- event_data[[3]]
  GroupPressNormal <- event_data[[4]]
  TurnOvers <- event_data[[5]]
  CounterAttackCounter <- event_data[[6]]
  CounterAttackNormal <- event_data[[7]]
  PLSCounter <- event_data[[8]]
  PLSNormal <- event_data[[9]]
  DPWCounter <- event_data[[10]]
  DPWNormal <- event_data[[11]]
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # TITLES AND CAPTION
  # ==========================================================
  
  teamtitle <- paste(title, " Press Type and Zones")
  
  method_caption <- ifelse(
    method == "quantile",
    "\nArea = central 75% of pressing activity using quantiles",
    "\nArea = pressing activity within 1.5 MAD of the median"
  )
  
  plot_subtitle <- paste(subtitle,
    method_caption,
    "\nDirection of play from left to right | Red fill = Counter Press | Circle = Press Leading to Shot",
    "\nSquare = Direct Possession Win | X = Failed Press | Diamond = Group Press | Star = Turnover| Triangle = Counter Attack"
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # BASE PLOT
  # ==========================================================
  
  touch_map <- ggplot() +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = pal,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = pal,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    
    annotate_pitch(
      dimensions = pitch_opta,
      fill = "#DBDBDB",
      colour = "#454545"
    ) +
    
    theme_pitch() +
    
    annotate(
      "segment",
      y = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9),
      yend = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9),
      x = 0,
      xend = 100,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = "#95A5A6",
      linetype = "longdash"
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83),
      xend = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83),
      y = 0,
      yend = 100,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = "#95A5A6",
      linetype = "longdash"
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 74.7,
      y = 50,
      label = "14",
      size = 4,
      colour = "grey"
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 74.7,
      y = 71.05,
      label = "LHS",
      size = 4,
      colour = "grey"
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 74.7,
      y = 28.95,
      label = "RHS",
      size = 4,
      colour = "grey"
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # PLAYER PRESS AREAS
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (nrow(press_area_data) > 0) {
    
    touch_map <- touch_map +
      
      geom_polygon(
        data = press_area_data,
        aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          group = .data$playerId,
          fill = .data$playerId,
          colour = .data$playerId,
          text = paste(
            "Player Press Zone:",
            .data$playerId
          )
        ),
        alpha = 0.15,
        linewidth = 0.5
      )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # PLAYER MEDIAN PRESS POSITIONS
  # ==========================================================
  
  touch_map <- touch_map +
    
    geom_point(
      data = PlayerPos,
      aes(
        x = .data$x,
        y = .data$y,
        fill = .data$playerId,
        colour = .data$playerId,
        text = paste(
          "Player:",
          .data$playerId,
          "\nPosition:",
          .data$Position,
          "\nMedian Press Position"
        )
      ),
      alpha = 0.8,
      shape = 21,
      size = 1.5,
      stroke = 0.5
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = PlayerPos,
      aes(
        x = .data$x,
        y = .data$y + 4,
        label = .data$playerId,
        colour = .data$playerId
      ),
      size = 2,
      fontface = "bold",
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # FAILED PRESSES
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (Fail == "Yes" && nrow(FailPress) > 0) {
    
    touch_map <- touch_map +
      
      geom_point(
        data = FailPress,
        aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          colour = .data$playerId,
          text = paste(
            "Player:",
            .data$playerId,
            "\nMinute:",
            .data$minute,
            "\nAction: Failed Press",
            "\nOutcome:",
            .data$Action_detail
          )
        ),
        shape = 4,
        size = 1.5,
        alpha = 0.8,
        stroke = 1
      )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # COUNTER PRESSES
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (CPress == "Yes" && nrow(CounterPress) > 0) {
    
    touch_map <- touch_map +
      
      geom_point(
        data = CounterPress,
        aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          colour = .data$playerId,
          text = paste(
            "Player:",
            .data$playerId,
            "\nMinute:",
            .data$minute,
            "\nAction: Counter Press",
            "\nOutcome:",
            .data$Action_detail
          )
        ),
        shape = 2,
        size = 1.5,
        alpha = 0.8,
        stroke = 1
      )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # GROUP PRESSES
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (GPress == "Yes") {
    
    if (nrow(GroupPressNormal) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = GroupPressNormal,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction: Group Press",
              "\nOutcome:",
              .data$Action_detail
            )
          ),
          shape = 23,
          fill = "#E5E5E5",
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
    
    if (nrow(GroupPressCounter) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = GroupPressCounter,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction: Counter Group Press",
              "\nOutcome:",
              .data$Action_detail
            )
          ),
          shape = 23,
          fill = color,
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # TURNOVERS
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (Turnover == "Yes" && nrow(TurnOvers) > 0) {
    
    touch_map <- touch_map +
      
      geom_point(
        data = TurnOvers,
        aes(
          x = .data$x,
          y = .data$y,
          colour = .data$playerId,
          text = paste(
            "Player:",
            .data$playerId,
            "\nMinute:",
            .data$minute,
            "\nAction:",
            .data$Action_detail,
            "\nOutcome: Turnover"
          )
        ),
        shape = 8,
        size = 1.5,
        alpha = 0.8,
        stroke = 1
      )
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # COUNTER ATTACKS
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (CAttack == "Yes") {
    
    if (nrow(CounterAttackNormal) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = CounterAttackNormal,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Counter Attack"
            )
          ),
          shape = 24,
          fill = "#E5E5E5",
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
    
    if (nrow(CounterAttackCounter) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = CounterAttackCounter,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Counter Attack"
            )
          ),
          shape = 24,
          fill = color,
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # DIRECT POSSESSION WINS
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (DPoss == "Yes") {
    
    if (nrow(DPWNormal) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = DPWNormal,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Direct Possession Win"
            )
          ),
          shape = 22,
          fill = "#E5E5E5",
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
    
    if (nrow(DPWCounter) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = DPWCounter,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Counter-Press Possession Win"
            )
          ),
          shape = 22,
          fill = color,
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.8,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # PRESS LEADING TO SHOT OR GOAL
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (PShot == "Yes") {
    
    if (nrow(PLSNormal) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = PLSNormal,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Chance Created"
            )
          ),
          shape = 21,
          fill = color,
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.9,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
    
    if (nrow(PLSCounter) > 0) {
      
      touch_map <- touch_map +
        
        geom_point(
          data = PLSCounter,
          aes(
            x = .data$x,
            y = .data$y,
            colour = .data$playerId,
            text = paste(
              "Player:",
              .data$playerId,
              "\nMinute:",
              .data$minute,
              "\nAction:",
              .data$Action_detail,
              "\nOutcome: Counter Press Created Chance"
            )
          ),
          shape = 21,
          fill = color,
          size = 1.5,
          alpha = 0.9,
          stroke = 1
        )
    }
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # FORMATTING
  # ==========================================================
  
  touch_map <- touch_map +
    
    labs(
      title = teamtitle,
      subtitle = plot_subtitle,
      caption = My_caption,
      x = ""
    ) +
    
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(
        colour = "snow", 
        fill = "snow"
      ),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#DBDBDB",
        colour = NA
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 4
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 6,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 4
      ),
      plot.caption = element_markdown(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # OPTIONAL LOGO
  # ==========================================================
  
  if (logo == "Yes") {
    
    touch_mapAI <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
      
      cowplot::draw_plot(
        touch_map,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        width = 1,
        height = 1,
        scale = 1
      ) +
      
      cowplot::draw_image(
        logo_AI,
        x = 0.4,
        y = 0.45,
        scale = 0.07
      )
    
  } else {
    
    touch_mapAI <- touch_map
  }
  
  
  return(touch_mapAI)
}
```

```{r}
#' Function for plotting shots for a team

plot_shot_AI <- function(data, type = "", teamColor = "#B22222", text_color = "", bins = 30, highlight_goals = "", average_location = "", matchFixture = "", mapName = "", mapType = "", matchDate = "", dataSource = "", logo = "", wrap = "") {
  
  # Checking data frame   
  if ((nrow(data) > 0) &&
      sum(c("minute", "x", "y", "xG", "xGOT", "NPxG", "result", "OTShots", "player", "Game_Period") %in% names(data)) == 10) {

    # set plot names
    if (dataSource == "UnderStat") {
      
      if (mapType == "Home") {
      
        home_team <- (data$home_team[nrow(data)])
        
        #shot_map_name <- paste0(home_team, " ", ShotTitle_text_Home)
        shot_map_name <- paste0(
  glue("<span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>{home_team}</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> Shot Map (</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>Goal,</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'> SoT</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> and </span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:#95A5A6;font-size:12px;'>No Goal</span><span style='color:gray12;font-size:12px;'>)</span>"))
      
      } else if (mapType == "Away") {
      
        away_team <- (data$away_team[nrow(data)])

        shot_map_name <- paste0(
  glue("<span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold \";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>{away_team}</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> Shot Map (</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>Goal,</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'> SoT</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> and </span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:#95A5A6;font-size:12px;'>No Goal</span><span style='color:gray12;font-size:12px;'>)</span>"))
    
      } else if (mapType == "Player") {  
      
        last <- sub(".* ", "", data$player[nrow(data)])

        player_name <- paste(first, last)
      
        shot_map_name <- paste0(
  glue("<span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>{player_name}</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> Shot Map (</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>Goal,</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'> SoT</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> and </span>><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:#95A5A6;font-size:12px;'>No Goal</span><span style='color:gray12;font-size:12px;'>)</span>"))
        
      } else if (mapType == "") {  
      
        shot_map_name <- paste(mapName, "Shot Map")
      }
      
    } else if (dataSource == "FotMob") {

        home_team <- (data$home_team[nrow(data)])

        shot_map_name <- paste0(

      } else if (mapType == "") {

      }
        
    } else if (dataSource == "Opta") {

       team_name <- (data$TeamName[nrow(data)])

      } else if (mapType == "Away") {
        
        away_team <- (data$TeamName[nrow(data)]) 
        shot_map_name <- paste0(
  glue("<span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>{away_team}</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> Shot Map (</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>Goal,</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'> SoT</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> and </span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:#95A5A6;font-size:12px;'>No Goal</span><span style='color:gray12;font-size:12px;'>)</span>"))
        
      } else if (mapType == "Player") {  
        
        player_name <- (data$playerId[nrow(data)])
        
        shot_map_name <- paste0(
  glue("<span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>{player_name}</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> Shot Map (</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'>Goal,</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:{teamColor};font-size:12px;'> SoT</span><span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:12px;'> and </span><span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:#95A5A6;font-size:12px;'>No Goal</span><span style='color:gray12;font-size:12px;'>)</span>"))
      
      } else if (mapType == "") {  
      
        shot_map_name <- paste(mapName, "Shot Map")
      }
    }
      
    fixture_name <- paste(matchFixture, "(",dataSource,")")
  

    # set Plot Colours and scale
    fill_b <- "#DBDBDB"
    pitch_lines <- "black"
    color_b <- teamColor
    colorLine <- "#95A5A6"
    colorText <- "black"
    fill_Goal <- c("No Goal" = fill_b,"SoT" = teamColor, "Goal" = teamColor)
    Alpha_Goal <- c("No Goal" = 0.9,"SoT" = 0.3, "Goal" = 1)
    # Data Wrangling 
    if (dataSource == "UnderStat") {
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(X = 100 * X) %>%
        mutate(Y = 100 * Y)
      
     } else if (dataSource == "FotMob") {
        data <- data %>%
             mutate(X = (X * 0.941050375),
                    Y = (Y * 1.464079972))
        
     } else if (dataSource == "Opta") {
        data <- data 
      }
    
    if (nrow(data) >= 1) {
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(xG = round(xG,2),
               isGoal = ifelse(result == "Goal", "Goal", ifelse(OTShots == 1, "SoT", "No Goal"))) 

              # set the pitch up
              plot <- data %>%
                ggplot() +
                annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, colour = pitch_lines, fill = fill_b) +
                theme_pitch() +
                annotate("segment", y = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9), yend = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9), x = 0, xend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6") +
                annotate("segment", x = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83), xend = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83), y = 0, yend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6") +

                
                # add zone numbers
                geom_text(aes(y = 50, x = 74.7, label = "14"), size = 3, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
                geom_text(aes(y = 71.05, x = 74.7, label = "LHS"), size = 3, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
                geom_text(aes(y = 28.95, x = 74.7, label = "RHS"), size = 3, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE)
              
              # geometrics 
              if (average_location == TRUE || average_location == "") {
                
                if (type == "point" || type == "") {
                  
                  if (highlight_goals == FALSE || highlight_goals == "") { ## Don't highlight goals ----
                    plot  <- plot +

                                     \n& xG"),
                        color = paste("Shot Result 
                                     \n& xG"),
                        size = "",
                      )
                  } else if (highlight_goals == TRUE) { ## Highlight goals ----
                    
                    plot <- plot +

                      geom_hline(yintercept = mean(data$y, na.rm = TRUE), color = colorLine, linetype = 2, linewidth = 1.5) +
                      labs(

                                     \n& xG"),
                        color = paste("Shot Result 
                                     \n& xG"),
                        size = ""
                      )
                  } 
                } else if (type == "density") { ## DENSITY ----

                    scale_fill_gradient(high = teamColor, low = text_color) +
                    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
                    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(data$x, na.rm = TRUE), color = colorLine, linetype = 2, linewidth = 1.5) +
                    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(data$y, na.rm = TRUE), color = colorLine, linetype = 2, linewidth = 1.5)
                  
                } else if (type == "hexbin") { ## HEXBIN ----
                  plot <- plot +
                    geom_hex(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y, text = paste("Player:", player, "\nMin:", minute, "\nOutcome:", result,  "\nxG", xG, "\nxGOT", xGOT)), bins = bins) +
                    scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
                    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +

                    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(data$y, na.rm = TRUE), color = colorLine, linetype = 2, linewidth = 1.5) +
                    labs(
                      fill = "Count of Shots"
                    )
                }
              } else if (average_location == FALSE) {
                
                if (type == "point" || type == "") {
                  
                  if (highlight_goals == FALSE || highlight_goals == "") {
                    plot <- plot +
                      geom_point(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y, size = xG, color = result, text = paste("Player:", player, "\nMin:", minute, "\nOutcome:", result, "\nxG", xG, "\nxGOT", xGOT)), alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.5) +
                      geom_image(data = filter(data, isGoal == "Goal"),
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, image = "~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Icons/ball3.png"), 
     by = "width", inherit.aes = TRUE
  ) +
                      
                      scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
                      labs(
                        color = paste("Shot Result 
                                     \n& xG"),
                        size = ""
                      )
                  } else if (highlight_goals == TRUE) {
                    
                    plot <- plot +
                      geom_point(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y, size = xG, fill = isGoal, alpha = isGoal, text = paste("Player:", player, "\nMin:", minute,  "\nOutcome:", result,  "\nxG", xG, "\nxGOT", xGOT)), color = color_b, shape = 21,  stroke = 0.5) +
                      
                      geom_image(data = filter(data, isGoal == "Goal"),
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, image = "~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Icons/ball3.png"),
    by = "width", inherit.aes = TRUE
  ) +
                      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_Goal) +
                      scale_alpha_manual(values = Alpha_Goal) +
                      scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
                      labs(
                        fill = paste("Shot Result 
                                     \n& xG"),
                        size = ""
                      )
                  } 
                } else if (type == "density") {
                  plot <- plot +
                    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level), text = paste("xG: ", ..level..)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
                    scale_fill_gradient(high = teamColor, low = text_color) +
                    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
                    labs(fill = "xG")
                  
                  
                } else if (type == "hexbin") {
                  plot <- plot +
                    geom_hex(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y, text = paste("Player:", player, "\nMin:", minute, "\nOutcome:", result,  "\nxG", xG, "\nxGOT", xGOT)), bins = bins) +
                    scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
                    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 6)) +
                    labs(
                      fill = "Count of Shots")
                } 
              }
```

```{r}
    playerId_short = dplyr::if_else(grepl(" ", playerId),
                                    sub(".*\\s", "", playerId),
                                    playerId)
  )

      #set range for text to change on player circle
      EPVRange <- (max(nodes$stat)) * 0.7
      
      # Plot

    plot_passnet <- ggplot() +
      
      #setup the pitch
      pitch_base(line_col = "#95A5A6", labels = TRUE) +
      
      #set scale and color gradient
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0000FF",  "red2"), labels = c("Won", "Lost"), name = "")

      
    if (pressmap == "Yes") {
      
      #plot pressing data
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
        geom_point(data = PressData, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = outcome), shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE)

    } else if (pressmap == "") {
     
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet
      
    }
      
      #plot player connections
    plot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
      new_scale_fill() +
      
      geom_segment(data = edges, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend, linewidth = (Total_Passes*0.25), colour = Pass_Suc)) +
      guides(linewidth = "none") +

      #plot player positions
      geom_point(data = nodes, aes(x, y, fill = stat, size = Attempted_Passes), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
      
      # set colour (50-100% range: player completion rarely drops below 50%,
      # so a 0-100% scale would make every line look the same shade)
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colors = c("#FFFFF0", scale_color),
        limits = c(0.5, 1),
        oob    = scales::squish,
        breaks = c(.5, .6, .7, .8, .9, 1),
        labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        name   = "Line Colour = Players' Pass Completion") +
      
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = c("#FFFFF0", scale_color),
        values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.5)), 
        breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.1), 
        name = "Circle Colour = Threat (EPV)") +
      
      # set scale
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10),
                        name = "Attempted Passes",
        guide = "none")
      
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
      new_scale_color() +
      
      #plot player Numbers
      geom_text(data = nodes,
          aes(x, y, label = player_shirt,
              color = stat > EPVRange,
              size = Successful_Passes/4),
          show.legend = FALSE) +
      
      # set scale    
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
      
      #formatting
      labs(title = PassNetTitle_text,
           subtitle = plotCaption,
           x = "",
           colour = leg_title,
           caption = My_caption) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow"),
            legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow"),
            plot.title = element_markdown(),
            plot.subtitle = element_markdown(),
            plot.caption = element_markdown(),
            plot.tag = element_markdown(),
            plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
            panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
            legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 4),
            legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 4),
            axis.title.x = element_blank())
    }
    
    # If half pitch
    
    if (pitch == "Half") {
      
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
        coord_flip(xlim = c(50, 100),
                   ylim = c(100, 00)) +
        scale_y_reverse() +
        labs(y = " ") +
        theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
              axis.title.x = element_blank())
      
    } else if (pitch == "Full") {
      
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet
      
    }
    
    # Press or not formatting
    
    if (pressmap == "Yes") {
      
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet +

        #formatting
        labs(title = PassNetTitle_textD,
             x = "",
             colour = leg_title)
      
    } else if (pressmap == "") {
      
      plot_passnet <- plot_passnet
    }

    # logo or not
  
    if (logo == "Yes") {
    
    # annotate plot
    Finalplot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
    annotation_custom(AI_Logo, xmin = 90, xmax = 100, ymin = 105, ymax = 115) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"))
    
    } else if (logo == "") {
      
      Finalplot_passnet <- plot_passnet +
        theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"))
    }

  return(Finalplot_passnet)
  #return(list(plot = Finalplot_passnet, nodes = nodes, edges = edges))

}
```

```{r}
# "Up to 1st subs" windows. Subs before min_sub_window (early injury subs)
# are skipped so the window is long enough to plot; the next sub is used.
# No subs (or no SubTime values) -> full match, rather than Inf / NA.
min_sub_window <- 15
first_sub_time <- function(team) {
  s <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(plottingData$SubTime[plottingData$TeamName == team]))
  s <- sort(unique(s[!is.na(s) & s != 0]))
  if (length(s) && min(s) < min_sub_window)
    message(team, ": early sub at ", min(s), " skipped for the 'up to 1st subs' charts")
  s <- s[s >= min_sub_window]
  if (length(s)) min(s) else max(as.numeric(plottingData$expandedMinute), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ---- own goals: credit them to the team that benefits ----------------
# An OG row carries the conceding team's TeamName and Goals = 0, so per-team
# goal markers miss it. team_rows_with_og() returns a team's rows without its
# own OGs, plus the opponent's OGs relabelled as a goal for this team, with
# the action counts zeroed (an OG adds no shots, xG, touches or EPV for them).
og_zero_cols <- c("xG", "NPxG", "xGOT", "EPVvalue", "EPV", "TeamEPV", "TeamxT", "Touches",
                  "Attempted_Passes", "Successful_Passes", "Successful_Carries",
                  "TotalShots", "OFShots", "OTShots", "Blocked_Shot")
team_rows_with_og <- function(df, team) {
  df %>%
    mutate(.og = coalesce(as.numeric(Own_Goals) == 1, FALSE),
           .og_for = .og & TeamName != team) %>%
    filter((TeamName == team & !.og) | .og_for) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(og_zero_cols), ~ ifelse(.og_for, 0, .x)),
           Goals = ifelse(.og_for, 1, Goals),
           Own_Goals = ifelse(.og_for, 0, Own_Goals),
           TeamName = ifelse(.og_for, team, TeamName)) %>%
    select(-.og, -.og_for)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: landing page setup
```
