```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Goals table - one row per goal, drives the scoreline, the xG race
# and the momentum chart. Own goals are credited to the other team.
# Minutes use the football convention (Opta minute + 1, stoppage
# shown as 45+2 / 90+3).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
fmt_match_minute <- function(minute, period) {
  disp <- minute + 1
  base <- c(45, 90, 105, 120)[pmin(pmax(period, 1), 4)]
  ifelse(disp > base, paste0(base, "+", disp - base, "'"), paste0(disp, "'"))
}

# Short display name: last word plus any surname particles before it
# ("Alexis Mac Allister" -> "Mac Allister", "Virgil van Dijk" -> "van Dijk")
surname_particles <- c("mac", "mc", "van", "von", "der", "den", "de", "di", "da", "do",
                       "dos", "das", "del", "della", "le", "la", "ter", "ten", "el", "al",
                       "bin", "ben", "st.", "saint")
short_name <- function(x) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(n) {
    if (is.na(n)) return(NA_character_)
    w <- strsplit(trimws(n), "\\s+")[[1]]
    if (length(w) <= 1) return(n)
    i <- length(w)
    while (i > 2 && tolower(w[i - 1]) %in% surname_particles) i <- i - 1
    paste(w[i:length(w)], collapse = " ")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

HomeAbbr <- toupper(substr(Match_Home, 1, 3))
AwayAbbr <- toupper(substr(Match_Away, 1, 3))

# Season tabs only show when a team has more than one game in the database
# (otherwise the season tables just repeat this match)
home_has_season <- n_distinct(SeasonData$game_name[SeasonData$TeamName == Match_Home]) > 1
away_has_season <- n_distinct(SeasonData$game_name[SeasonData$TeamName == Match_Away]) > 1

has_situation <- "situation" %in% names(plottingData)

goal_events <- plottingData %>%
  filter(`type/value` == 16, period < 5) %>%
  mutate(
    OG = coalesce(Own_Goals == 1, FALSE),
    Pen = if (has_situation) coalesce(situation == "Penalty", FALSE) else FALSE,
    Scoring_Team = ifelse(OG, ifelse(TeamName == Match_Home, Match_Away, Match_Home), TeamName),
    Surname = short_name(playerId),
    Minute_Label = fmt_match_minute(minute, period),
    Label = paste0(Surname, " ", Minute_Label,
                   ifelse(Pen, " (pen)", ""), ifelse(OG, " (OG)", ""))
  ) %>%
  arrange(expandedMinute) %>%
  select(Scoring_Team, playerId, Surname, minute, expandedMinute, period, OG, Pen, Minute_Label, Label)

sub_events <- plottingData %>%

# goal marker image used across the dashboard

# EPV to xG conversion (same definition as 'EPV % xG Con.' in the summary tables)
HomeEPVxG <- if (HomeEPV > 0) round(100 * HomexG / HomeEPV) else NA
AwayEPVxG <- if (AwayEPV > 0) round(100 * AwayxG / AwayEPV) else NA

HomexGOT <- round(sum(plottingData$xGOT[plottingData$TeamName == Match_Home], na.rm = TRUE), 2)
AwayxGOT <- round(sum(plottingData$xGOT[plottingData$TeamName == Match_Away], na.rm = TRUE), 2)

HT_minute <- max(plottingData$expandedMinute[plottingData$period == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
FT_minute <- max(plottingData$expandedMinute[plottingData$period < 5], na.rm = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Auto-generated summary line
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
peak_tilt <- plottingData %>%
  filter(Game_Quarter != "Injury Time", Final_Third_Touches == 1) %>%
  count(Game_Quarter, TeamName) %>%
  group_by(Game_Quarter) %>%
  mutate(Tilt = round(100 * n / sum(n))) %>%
  group_by(TeamName) %>%
  slice_max(Tilt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

tilt_phrase <- function(team) {
  r <- peak_tilt %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL)
  paste0(team, "'s peak field tilt was ", r$Tilt, "% in the ", r$Game_Quarter)
}

xg_txt <- paste0(format(HomexG, nsmall = 2), " vs ", format(AwayxG, nsmall = 2))
if (HomeGoals == AwayGoals) {
  result_txt <- paste0(Match_Home, " drew ", HomeGoals, "–", AwayGoals, " with ", Match_Away,
                       " (xG ", xg_txt, ")")
} else {
  home_won <- HomeGoals > AwayGoals
  winner   <- if (home_won) Match_Home else Match_Away
  loser    <- if (home_won) Match_Away else Match_Home
  w_xg     <- if (home_won) HomexG else AwayxG
  l_xg     <- if (home_won) AwayxG else HomexG
  score    <- if (home_won) paste0(HomeGoals, "–", AwayGoals) else paste0(AwayGoals, "–", HomeGoals)
  xg_clause <- if (w_xg < l_xg) {
    paste0("despite trailing on xG (", format(w_xg, nsmall = 2), " vs ", format(l_xg, nsmall = 2), ")")
  } else {
    paste0("with the better of the xG (", format(w_xg, nsmall = 2), " vs ", format(l_xg, nsmall = 2), ")")
  }
  result_txt <- paste(winner, "beat", loser, score, xg_clause)
}
summary_line <- paste0(paste(c(result_txt, tilt_phrase(Match_Home), tilt_phrase(Match_Away)),
                             collapse = ". "), ".")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Combined xG race data (both teams, same axes)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
xg_race <- plottingData %>%
  filter(TotalShots == 1, period < 5, !coalesce(Own_Goals == 1, FALSE)) %>%
  select(TeamName, expandedMinute, xG) %>%
  mutate(xG = coalesce(xG, 0)) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(TeamName = c(Match_Home, Match_Away), expandedMinute = 0, xG = 0)) %>%
  arrange(TeamName, expandedMinute) %>%
  group_by(TeamName) %>%
  mutate(cum_xG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(.x, tibble(expandedMinute = FT_minute, xG = 0, cum_xG = max(.x$cum_xG)))) %>%
  ungroup()

cum_xg_at <- function(team, minute) {
  d <- xg_race %>% filter(TeamName == team, expandedMinute <= minute)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) 0 else max(d$cum_xG)
}
goal_points <- goal_events %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cum_xG = cum_xg_at(Scoring_Team, expandedMinute)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Cumulative EPV race (same layout as the xG race). Successful actions
# only, matching HomeEPV / AwayEPV, so each line ends on the team total.
epv_race <- plottingData %>%
  filter(`outcomeType/value` == 1, TeamName %in% c(Match_Home, Match_Away)) %>%
  select(TeamName, expandedMinute, EPVvalue) %>%
  mutate(EPVvalue = coalesce(EPVvalue, 0)) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(TeamName = c(Match_Home, Match_Away), expandedMinute = 0, EPVvalue = 0)) %>%
  arrange(TeamName, expandedMinute) %>%
  group_by(TeamName) %>%
  mutate(cum_EPV = cumsum(EPVvalue)) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(.x, tibble(expandedMinute = FT_minute, EPVvalue = 0,
                                      cum_EPV = last(.x$cum_EPV)))) %>%
  ungroup()

cum_epv_at <- function(team, minute) {
  d <- epv_race %>% filter(TeamName == team, expandedMinute <= minute)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) 0 else last(d$cum_EPV)
}
epv_goal_points <- goal_events %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cum_EPV = cum_epv_at(Scoring_Team, expandedMinute)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Momentum: rolling 5-minute EPV difference (home minus away)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
momentum_window <- 5

momentum <- plottingData %>%
  filter(period < 5) %>%
  mutate(v = ifelse(`outcomeType/value` == 1, coalesce(EPVvalue, 0), 0),
         m = floor(expandedMinute)) %>%
  group_by(m) %>%
  summarise(home = sum(v[TeamName == Match_Home]),
            away = sum(v[TeamName == Match_Away]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(m = 0:max(m), fill = list(home = 0, away = 0)) %>%
  arrange(m) %>%
  mutate(diff = slide_dbl(home - away, sum, .before = momentum_window - 1))

# interpolate to 0.1 min so the fill switches colour cleanly at zero
momentum_fine <- tibble(m = seq(0, max(momentum$m), by = 0.1)) %>%
  mutate(diff = approx(momentum$m, momentum$diff, xout = m)$y)

mom_lim <- max(abs(momentum_fine$diff), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Share-based momentum: rolling share of an event flag (touches,
# final-third touches) centred on 50%. + = home team, - = away team.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
share_momentum <- function(flag_col, window = momentum_window) {
  m_max <- max(momentum$m)
  per_min <- plottingData %>%
    filter(period < 5, coalesce(.data[[flag_col]], 0) == 1) %>%
    mutate(m = floor(expandedMinute)) %>%
    group_by(m) %>%
    summarise(home = sum(TeamName == Match_Home), away = sum(TeamName == Match_Away), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(m = 0:m_max, fill = list(home = 0, away = 0)) %>%
    arrange(m) %>%
    mutate(home_r = slide_dbl(home, sum, .before = window - 1),
           away_r = slide_dbl(away, sum, .before = window - 1),
           share  = ifelse(home_r + away_r > 0, 100 * home_r / (home_r + away_r) - 50, 0))
  tibble(m = seq(0, m_max, by = 0.1)) %>%
    mutate(diff = approx(per_min$m, per_min$share, xout = m)$y)
}

touch_momentum_fine <- share_momentum("Touches")
tilt_momentum_fine  <- share_momentum("Final_Third_Touches")

# Diverging momentum chart with goals (dotted) and subs (triangles) marked.
# share = TRUE labels the y axis as a % share centred on 50%.
plot_momentum <- function(df, title, subtitle, ylab, home_lab, away_lab, share = TRUE) {
  lim <- max(c(abs(df$diff), if (share) 10 else 0), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.25
  gl <- goal_events %>% mutate(y  = ifelse(Scoring_Team == Match_Home, lim * 0.90, -lim * 0.90),
                               yl = ifelse(Scoring_Team == Match_Home, lim * 0.74, -lim * 0.74))
  sm <- sub_events %>% mutate(y = ifelse(TeamName == Match_Home, lim * 0.99, -lim * 0.99),
                              shape = ifelse(TeamName == Match_Home, 25, 24))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = m)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = pmax(diff, 0)), fill = Color_Home, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmin(diff, 0), ymax = 0), fill = Color_Away, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = HT_minute, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = goal_events, aes(xintercept = expandedMinute),
               linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_image(data = gl, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = y, image = ball_icon), size = 0.035) +
    geom_label(data = gl, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = yl, label = Label, fill = Scoring_Team),
               colour = ifelse(gl$Scoring_Team == Match_Home, Color_Home_Text, Color_Away_Text),
               size = 2.1, label.size = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = sm, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = y, shape = shape),
               fill = "grey30", colour = "grey30", size = 1.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(Color_Home, Color_Away), c(Match_Home, Match_Away))) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = lim * 0.55, label = home_lab,
             hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = Color_Home, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = -lim * 0.55, label = away_lab,
             hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = Color_Away_Text, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 135, 15)) +
    { if (share) scale_y_continuous(labels = function(v) paste0(round(abs(v) + 50), "%")) } +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "Match Time (Mins)", y = ylab, caption = My_caption) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
          panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 7),
          plot.caption = element_markdown(),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 7),
          axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 7, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: enhancement setup
#| output: false

# ===============================================================
# Event sequences + helpers for the set-piece, shot-sequence, entry,
# transition, defensive-shape, PPDA, substitution and goalkeeper
# sections. Opta coordinates (0-100), each team attacking left to right.
# Definitions are written up on the Methodology page.
# ===============================================================

# ---- small helpers ------------------------------------------------
num0 <- function(df, col) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])), 0) else rep(0, nrow(df))
}
numNA <- function(df, col) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
}
has_qual <- function(df, code) {
  qc <- grep("^qualifiers/\\d+/type/value$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(qc) == 0) return(rep(FALSE, nrow(df)))
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(qc, function(cl) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cl]])) == code, FALSE)))
}
opp_of     <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Match_Away, Match_Home)
team_col   <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Color_Home, Color_Away)
team_txt   <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Color_Home_Text, Color_Away_Text)
team_cols  <- setNames(c(Color_Home, Color_Away), c(Match_Home, Match_Away))
team_scale <- function(team) c("#FFFAFA", team_col(team))   # snow -> team colour, for gt_color_rows
# dashboard standard: blue = successful / better, red = unsuccessful / worse
col_success <- "#0000FF"
col_fail    <- "#BD1100"
# team-coloured facet strips (one team per plot)
team_strip <- function(team) {
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, colour = team_txt(team)),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = team_col(team), color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1))
}
pct_txt    <- function(a, b) ifelse(b > 0, paste0(round(100 * a / b), "%"), "-")
channel_levels <- c("Left wing", "Left half-space", "Central", "Right half-space", "Right wing")
channel_of <- function(y) {
  factor(case_when(y >= 78.9 ~ "Left wing", y >= 63.2 ~ "Left half-space", y >= 36.8 ~ "Central",
                   y >= 21.1 ~ "Right half-space", TRUE ~ "Right wing"), levels = channel_levels)
}
third_of <- function(x) case_when(x >= 66.7 ~ "Att third", x >= 33.3 ~ "Mid third", TRUE ~ "Def third")
in_box   <- function(x, y) coalesce(x >= 83 & y >= 21.1 & y <= 78.9, FALSE)
quarter_levels <- c("1st Quarter", "2nd Quarter", "3rd Quarter", "4th Quarter", "Injury Time")

# styled gt used by the new tables (matches the summary tables)
ai_gt <- function(df, title, subtitle = Match_Fixture, group = NULL, rowname = NULL) {
  gt(df, groupname_col = group, rowname_col = rowname) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(paste0("**", title, "**")), subtitle = subtitle) %>%
    tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
    cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "-") %>%
    tab_options(heading.padding = px(1), heading.align = "left",
                column_labels.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
                row_group.background.color = "ivory4",
                stub.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
                column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
                table.font.size = 13, heading.title.font.size = 16,
                heading.subtitle.font.size = 13, source_notes.font.size = 8,
                table.width = "100%") %>%
    tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),
              style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16)))
}
# colour team row groups / spanners when present
gt_team_groups <- function(tbl, groups) {
  for (tm in intersect(c(Match_Home, Match_Away), groups)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>% tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(tm)),
                                          cell_fill(color = team_col(tm))),
                             locations = cells_row_groups(groups = tm))
  }
  tbl
}
gt_team_spanners <- function(tbl) {
  for (tm in c(Match_Home, Match_Away)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>% tab_spanner(label = tm, id = tm, columns = starts_with(paste0(tm, " | "))) %>%
      tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(tm)), cell_fill(color = team_col(tm))),
                locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = tm))
  }
  tbl %>% cols_label_with(columns = contains(" | "), fn = function(n) sub("^.* \\| ", "", n))
}

# ---- event table in match order -------------------------------------
ev <- plottingData %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(period < 5) %>%
  arrange(period, .row)

ev <- ev %>%
  mutate(
    tv        = num0(ev, "type/value"),
    out       = num0(ev, "outcomeType/value"),
    sec       = coalesce(as.numeric(minute), 0) * 60 + num0(ev, "second"),
    OG        = num0(ev, "Own_Goals") == 1,
    # all passes incl. throw-ins, corners and offside passes (Attempted_Passes
    # leaves some set-piece passes out)
    is_pass   = tv %in% c(1, 2),
    is_shot   = num0(ev, "TotalShots") == 1 & !OG,
    on_target = num0(ev, "OTShots") == 1,
    is_cross  = num0(ev, "Cross_Passes") == 1,
    is_long   = num0(ev, "Long_Passes") == 1,
    da        = num0(ev, "Defensive_Action") == 1,
    ft_touch  = num0(ev, "Final_Third_Touches") == 1,
    xg        = num0(ev, "xG"),
    xgot      = num0(ev, "xGOT"),
    epv       = num0(ev, "EPVvalue"),
    x         = numNA(ev, "x"),
    y         = numNA(ev, "y"),
    end_x     = numNA(ev, "finalX"),
    end_y     = numNA(ev, "finalY"),
    dist_m    = sqrt(((end_x - x) * 1.05)^2 + ((end_y - y) * 0.68)^2),
    short_flag = num0(ev, "Short_Corners") == 1,
    corner    = is_pass & (num0(ev, "Corners") == 1 | short_flag | has_qual(ev, 6)),
    free_kick = is_pass & !corner & (num0(ev, "FreeKicks") == 1 | has_qual(ev, 5)),
    throw_in  = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 107),
    goal_kick = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 124),
    kick_off  = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 279),
    dead_ball = corner | free_kick | throw_in | goal_kick | kick_off,
    pen       = is_shot & has_qual(ev, 9),
    blocked   = is_shot & has_qual(ev, 82),
    sit       = if ("situation" %in% names(ev)) as.character(situation) else NA_character_,
    # events where a team has the ball - a change of team starts a new sequence
    on_ball   = is_pass | is_shot | tv %in% c(3, 8, 49, 52, 54, 61) |
                (tv %in% c(7, 11) & out == 1),
    # PPDA defensive actions: tackles, interceptions, challenges, fouls committed
    ppda_da   = tv %in% c(7, 8, 45) | (tv == 4 & out == 0)
  )

# ---- sequences: new one when the team on the ball changes, the period
#      changes, or play restarts from a dead ball ---------------------
seq_ids <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball) %>%
  mutate(new_seq = row_number() == 1 |
                   coalesce(TeamName != dplyr::lag(TeamName), TRUE) |
                   coalesce(period != dplyr::lag(period), TRUE) | dead_ball,
         seq_id = cumsum(new_seq)) %>%
  select(.row, seq_id)

ev <- ev %>%
  left_join(seq_ids, by = ".row") %>%
  tidyr::fill(seq_id, .direction = "down") %>%
  group_by(seq_id) %>%
  mutate(cum_passes = cumsum(is_pass & on_ball)) %>%
  ungroup()

seqs <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball, !is.na(seq_id)) %>%
  group_by(seq_id) %>%
  summarise(TeamName = dplyr::first(TeamName), period = dplyr::first(period),
            start_row = dplyr::first(.row), start_sec = dplyr::first(sec), start_min = dplyr::first(expandedMinute),
            start_x = dplyr::first(x), start_y = dplyr::first(y), starter = dplyr::first(playerId),
            start_tv = dplyr::first(tv), s_corner = dplyr::first(corner), s_fk = dplyr::first(free_kick),
            s_throw = dplyr::first(throw_in), s_gk = dplyr::first(goal_kick), s_ko = dplyr::first(kick_off),
            n_events = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(start_type = case_when(s_corner ~ "Corner", s_fk ~ "Free kick", s_throw ~ "Throw-in",
                                s_gk ~ "Goal kick", s_ko ~ "Kick-off",
                                start_tv %in% c(10, 11, 52, 54) ~ "Keeper",
                                TRUE ~ "Open-play regain"),
         start_zone = paste0(third_of(start_x), ", ", channel_of(start_y)))

# ---- shots joined back to their sequence ---------------------------
shot_class <- function(sit, start_type, pen) {
  s <- tolower(coalesce(sit, ""))
  case_when(pen | grepl("pen", s) ~ "Penalty",
            grepl("corner|set ?piece|free ?kick|throw", s) ~ "Set piece",
            s %in% c("", "na") & start_type %in% c("Corner", "Free kick", "Throw-in") ~ "Set piece",
            TRUE ~ "Open play")
}

shot_seq <- ev %>%
  filter(is_shot) %>%
  select(.row, seq_id, TeamName, playerId, expandedMinute, minute, period, sec,
         shot_x = x, shot_y = y, xg, xgot, tv, pen, blocked, on_target, sit, cum_passes) %>%
  left_join(seqs %>% select(seq_id, start_sec, start_x, start_y, starter, start_type, start_zone),
            by = "seq_id") %>%
  mutate(Shooter  = short_name(playerId),
         Starter  = short_name(starter),
         Duration = pmax(0, round(sec - start_sec)),
         Passes   = cum_passes,
         Goal     = tv == 16,
         Result   = case_when(tv == 16 ~ "Goal", blocked ~ "Blocked", tv == 15 ~ "Saved",
                              tv == 14 ~ "Post", TRUE ~ "Off target"),
         Class    = shot_class(sit, start_type, pen),
         Min      = fmt_match_minute(minute, period))

# ---- set pieces ----------------------------------------------------
ev_idx <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(ev)), ev$.row)
contact_cand <- ev$on_ball | ev$tv %in% c(4, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 41, 44, 45, 74)

# team that makes the first contact after a delivery (aerial duels go to
# the winner); NA if the ball goes out / play stops before anyone touches it
first_contact_team <- function(r) {
  i <- ev_idx[[as.character(r)]]
  if (i >= nrow(ev)) return(NA_character_)
  j <- (i + 1):min(i + 6, nrow(ev))
  j <- j[coalesce(ev$period[j] == ev$period[i] & (ev$sec[j] - ev$sec[i]) <= 8, FALSE)]
  stop_at <- which(ev$tv[j] %in% c(5, 6) | ev$dead_ball[j])
  if (length(stop_at)) j <- j[seq_len(stop_at[1] - 1)]
  j <- j[contact_cand[j]]
  if (length(j) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (ev$tv[j[1]] == 44) {
    a <- j[ev$tv[j] == 44 & ev$out[j] == 1]
    if (length(a)) return(as.character(ev$TeamName[a[1]]))
  }
  as.character(ev$TeamName[j[1]])
}

sp_events <- ev %>%
  filter(corner | free_kick | throw_in) %>%
  mutate(sp_type  = case_when(corner ~ "Corner", free_kick ~ "Free kick", TRUE ~ "Throw-in"),
         short    = corner & (short_flag | coalesce(dist_m < 20, FALSE)),
         delivery = case_when(sp_type == "Corner" & short ~ "Short corner",
                              sp_type == "Corner" ~ "Direct corner",
                              in_box(end_x, end_y) ~ "Into box",
                              coalesce(end_x >= 66.7, FALSE) ~ "Into final third",
                              TRUE ~ "Other"),
         contact_team  = vapply(.row, first_contact_team, character(1)),
         First_Contact = case_when(is.na(contact_team) ~ "No contact",
                                   contact_team == TeamName ~ "Won", TRUE ~ "Lost"),
         Taker = short_name(playerId))

sp_summary_team <- function(team) {
  s  <- sp_events %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  co <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Corner")
  dc <- co %>% filter(delivery == "Direct corner")
  fk <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Free kick")
  ti <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Throw-in")
  sh <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  cls <- function(k, f) { d <- sh %>% filter(Class == k); f(d) }
  tibble(
    Section = c(rep("Corners", 4), rep("Free kicks", 3), rep("Throw-ins", 2),
                rep("Shots by situation", 9)),
    Metric = c("Corners taken", "Short", "Direct", "Direct - first contact won",
               "Free kicks (passes)", "Into final third / box", "Into box",
               "Throw-ins", "Retained (first touch)",
               "Open-play shots", "Open-play xG", "Open-play goals",
               "Set-piece shots", "Set-piece xG", "Set-piece goals",
               "Penalties", "Penalty xG", "Set-piece share of xG"),
    Value = c(nrow(co), sum(co$short), nrow(dc),
              paste0(sum(dc$First_Contact == "Won"), " (", pct_txt(sum(dc$First_Contact == "Won"), nrow(dc)), ")"),
              nrow(fk), sum(fk$delivery %in% c("Into box", "Into final third")), sum(fk$delivery == "Into box"),
              nrow(ti), pct_txt(sum(ti$First_Contact == "Won"), nrow(ti)),
              cls("Open play", nrow), format(round(cls("Open play", function(d) sum(d$xg)), 2), nsmall = 2), cls("Open play", function(d) sum(d$Goal)),
              cls("Set piece", nrow), format(round(cls("Set piece", function(d) sum(d$xg)), 2), nsmall = 2), cls("Set piece", function(d) sum(d$Goal)),
              cls("Penalty", nrow), format(round(cls("Penalty", function(d) sum(d$xg)), 2), nsmall = 2),
              pct_txt(cls("Set piece", function(d) sum(d$xg)), sum(sh$xg))) %>% as.character()
  )
}
sp_summary <- sp_summary_team(Match_Home) %>%
  dplyr::rename(!!Match_Home := Value) %>%
  left_join(sp_summary_team(Match_Away) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Away := Value), by = c("Section", "Metric"))

# ---- carries: the ball moved between receiving it (end of the previous
#      same-team event) and the next action, within one sequence, 5m+ ----
# Use the pipeline's carries when the match file has them (Carry_Start_X/Y,
# added in the corrected Match_Event_Data_Analysis_V5.R); otherwise fall back
# to the dashboard's own carry definition for files processed earlier.
pipeline_carries <- all(c("Carry_Start_X", "Carry_Start_Y", "C_End_point_X", "C_End_point_Y") %in% names(ev))
carries <- if (pipeline_carries) {
  ev %>%
    filter(num0(ev, "Attempted_Carries") == 1) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, playerId, period,
              x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Carry_Start_X)), y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Carry_Start_Y)),
              end_x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(C_End_point_X)), end_y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(C_End_point_Y)),
              Kind = "Carry", Success = coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Successful_Carries)), 0) == 1)
} else {
  ev %>%
    filter(on_ball) %>%
    mutate(prev_ok = dplyr::lag(is_pass & out == 1),
           c_x = ifelse(coalesce(prev_ok, FALSE), dplyr::lag(end_x), dplyr::lag(x)),
           c_y = ifelse(coalesce(prev_ok, FALSE), dplyr::lag(end_y), dplyr::lag(y)),
           same_seq = coalesce(seq_id == dplyr::lag(seq_id), FALSE) & !dead_ball,
           c_dist = sqrt(((x - c_x) * 1.05)^2 + ((y - c_y) * 0.68)^2)) %>%
    filter(same_seq, coalesce(c_dist >= 5, FALSE)) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, playerId, period, x = c_x, y = c_y, end_x = x, end_y = y,
              Kind = "Carry", Success = TRUE)
}

# ---- box and final-third entries (open play) ----------------------
entries <- bind_rows(
  ev %>% filter(is_pass, !dead_ball) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, playerId, period, x, y, end_x, end_y, Kind = "Pass", Success = out == 1),
  carries
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(end_x)) %>%
  mutate(box_entry = !in_box(x, y) & in_box(end_x, end_y),
         ft_entry  = x < 66.7 & end_x >= 66.7,
         Channel   = channel_of(y)) %>%
  filter(box_entry | ft_entry)

entry_summary <- function(d, flag) {
  d %>% filter(.data[[flag]]) %>%
    group_by(TeamName, Channel, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(Passes = sum(Kind == "Pass"), Carries = sum(Kind == "Carry"),
              Total = n(), Succ = sum(Success), .groups = "drop")
}
entry_table <- bind_rows(
  entry_summary(entries %>% mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))), "box_entry") %>% mutate(Type = "Box"),
  entry_summary(entries %>% mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))), "ft_entry")  %>% mutate(Type = "Final third")
) %>%
  mutate(TeamName = as.character(TeamName), Channel = as.character(Channel))
entry_table <- bind_rows(
  entry_table,
  entry_table %>% group_by(TeamName, Type) %>%
    summarise(across(c(Passes, Carries, Total, Succ), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Channel = "Total")
) %>%
  mutate(`Success %` = ifelse(Total > 0, round(100 * Succ / Total), NA)) %>%
  select(-Succ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = c(Passes, Carries, Total, `Success %`),
              names_glue = "{Type} | {.value}", values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Channel = factor(Channel, levels = c(channel_levels, "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)), Channel) %>%
  mutate(Channel = as.character(Channel)) %>%
  select(TeamName, Channel, starts_with("Box | "), starts_with("Final third | "))

# ---- transitions --------------------------------------------------
regain_seqs <- seqs %>% filter(start_type == "Open-play regain")
regain_shots <- shot_seq %>% filter(start_type == "Open-play regain")
fast_window <- 15   # seconds

transition_team <- function(team) {
  rs <- regain_seqs %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  sh <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  fs <- sh %>% filter(Duration <= fast_window)
  oc <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == opp_of(team), Duration <= fast_window)
  first_shot <- sh %>% group_by(seq_id) %>% summarise(t = min(Duration), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(
    Metric = c("Open-play regains", "Regains in attacking third", "Regains leading to a shot",
               paste0("Shots within ", fast_window, "s of regain"), paste0("xG within ", fast_window, "s"),
               paste0("Goals within ", fast_window, "s"), "Median time regain to shot (s)",
               paste0("Shots conceded within ", fast_window, "s of losing ball"),
               paste0("xG conceded within ", fast_window, "s"), paste0("Goals conceded within ", fast_window, "s")),
    Value = c(nrow(rs), sum(rs$start_x >= 66.7, na.rm = TRUE), n_distinct(sh$seq_id),
              nrow(fs), format(round(sum(fs$xg), 2), nsmall = 2), sum(fs$Goal),
              if (nrow(first_shot)) round(median(first_shot$t)) else "-",
              nrow(oc), format(round(sum(oc$xg), 2), nsmall = 2), sum(oc$Goal)) %>% as.character()
  )
}
transition_summary <- transition_team(Match_Home) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Home := Value) %>%
  left_join(transition_team(Match_Away) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Away := Value), by = "Metric")

# ---- defensive shape by quarter -----------------------------------
shape_data <- ev %>%
  filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(Game_Quarter)) %>%
  mutate(Game_Quarter = factor(Game_Quarter, levels = quarter_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Game_Quarter))

# Block method, like the touch-area plots:
#   "mad"      = median +/- 1.5 MAD (robust; about the middle 75% when the
#                spread is roughly normal) and a convex hull of the defensive
#                actions inside it, with the median as the block line
#   "quantile" = 10th-90th percentile box with the mean as the block line
block_method <- "mad"
mad_k <- 1.5           # width of the MAD band (1 = tighter block)
block_shape <- "box"   # "box" = rectangle from the bounds, "hull" = outline of the actions inside
block_bounds <- function(v, lo_q = 0.1, hi_q = 0.9) {
  if (block_method == "mad") {
    m <- median(v); s <- median(abs(v - m)) / 0.6745
    c(lo = max(0, m - mad_k * s), hi = min(100, m + mad_k * s), mid = m)
  } else {
    c(lo = unname(quantile(v, lo_q)), hi = unname(quantile(v, hi_q)), mid = mean(v))
  }
}

def_shape <- shape_data %>%
  filter(da) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, Game_Quarter) %>%
  summarise(`Def. actions` = n(),
            `DA height (m)` = round(mean(x) * 1.05, 1),
            x10 = block_bounds(x)[["lo"]], x90 = block_bounds(x)[["hi"]],
            y10 = block_bounds(y)[["lo"]], y90 = block_bounds(y)[["hi"]],
            xm = block_bounds(x)[["mid"]],
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(`Block depth (m)` = round((x90 - x10) * 1.05, 1),
         `Block width (m)` = round((y90 - y10) * 0.68, 1),
         `Block line (m)` = round(xm * 1.05, 1)) %>%
  left_join(shape_data %>% filter(on_ball) %>% group_by(TeamName, Game_Quarter) %>%
              summarise(`On-ball height (m)` = round(mean(x) * 1.05, 1), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("TeamName", "Game_Quarter")) %>%
  left_join(shape_data %>% filter(ft_touch) %>% count(Game_Quarter, TeamName) %>%
              group_by(Game_Quarter) %>% mutate(`Field tilt %` = round(100 * n / sum(n))) %>%
              ungroup() %>% select(-n),
            by = c("TeamName", "Game_Quarter"))

# score at the start of each quarter, from the goals table
quarter_start <- c(`1st Quarter` = 0, `2nd Quarter` = 25, `3rd Quarter` = HT_minute, `4th Quarter` = HT_minute + 25, `Injury Time` = 90)
score_at <- function(m) paste0(sum(goal_events$Scoring_Team == Match_Home & goal_events$expandedMinute < m), "-",
                               sum(goal_events$Scoring_Team == Match_Away & goal_events$expandedMinute < m))
def_shape <- def_shape %>%
  mutate(`Score at start` = vapply(as.character(Game_Quarter), function(q) score_at(quarter_start[[q]]), character(1)))

# convex hull of the defensive actions inside each block (used when block_method = "mad")
block_hull <- shape_data %>%
  filter(da) %>%
  inner_join(def_shape %>% select(TeamName, Game_Quarter, x10, x90, y10, y90),
             by = c("TeamName", "Game_Quarter")) %>%
  filter(x >= x10, x <= x90, y >= y10, y <= y90) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, Game_Quarter) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  slice(chull(x, y)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- proper PPDA: opponent passes in their own 60% / your defensive
#      actions in that same zone (your attacking 60%) ----------------
ppda_calc <- function(d, team) {
  passes <- sum(d$is_pass & d$TeamName == opp_of(team) & coalesce(d$x <= 60, FALSE))
  das    <- sum(d$ppda_da & d$TeamName == team & coalesce(d$x >= 40, FALSE))
  c(passes = passes, das = das, ppda = if (das > 0) round(passes / das, 2) else NA_real_)
}
ppda_periods <- list(
  `Full Time` = ev,
  `1st Half` = ev %>% filter(period == 1),
  `2nd Half` = ev %>% filter(period == 2),
  `1st Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "1st Quarter"),
  `2nd Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "2nd Quarter"),
  `3rd Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "3rd Quarter"),
  `4th Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "4th Quarter")
)
ppda_proper <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ppda_periods), function(p) {
  d <- ppda_periods[[p]]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  h <- ppda_calc(d, Match_Home); a <- ppda_calc(d, Match_Away)
  tibble(Period = p,
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | Opp. passes") := h[["passes"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | Def. actions") := h[["das"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | PPDA") := h[["ppda"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | Opp. passes") := a[["passes"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | Def. actions") := a[["das"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | PPDA") := a[["ppda"]])
}))
HomePPDA_Proper <- ppda_proper[[paste0(Match_Home, " | PPDA")]][1]
AwayPPDA_Proper <- ppda_proper[[paste0(Match_Away, " | PPDA")]][1]

# ---- one PPDA definition across the dashboard ----------------------
# "standard" = opponent passes in their own 60% / tackles, interceptions,
#              challenges and fouls committed in that zone (used everywhere:
#              value box, PPDA development plots, table, sub windows, report)
# "simple"   = the pipeline's original all passes / all defensive actions
ppda_definition <- "standard"
HomePPDA_Simple <- HomePPDA
AwayPPDA_Simple <- AwayPPDA
if (ppda_definition == "standard") {
  HomePPDA <- HomePPDA_Proper
  AwayPPDA <- AwayPPDA_Proper
  # cumulative standard PPDA through the match, in event order. Files from the
  # V7 pipeline onward already hold these (PPDA_Pass column present), so this
  # only rebuilds them for older processed files that used the simple version.
  if (!"PPDA_Pass" %in% names(plottingData)) {
  tv_p  <- num0(plottingData, "type/value")
  out_p <- num0(plottingData, "outcomeType/value")
  x_p   <- numNA(plottingData, "x")
  pass_own60 <- tv_p %in% c(1, 2) & coalesce(x_p <= 60, FALSE)
  da_zone    <- (tv_p %in% c(7, 8, 45) | (tv_p == 4 & out_p == 0)) & coalesce(x_p >= 40, FALSE)
  cum_ppda <- function(passes, das) round(ifelse(das > 0, passes / das, 0), 2)
  plottingData$Home_PPDA_Cumalative <- cum_ppda(cumsum(pass_own60 & plottingData$TeamName == Match_Away),
                                                cumsum(da_zone & plottingData$TeamName == Match_Home))
  plottingData$Away_PPDA_Cumalative <- cum_ppda(cumsum(pass_own60 & plottingData$TeamName == Match_Home),
                                                cumsum(da_zone & plottingData$TeamName == Match_Away))
  }
}
# y-axis ceiling for the PPDA development plots (early-match values spike
# while few defensive actions have been made)
ppda_ylim <- max(12, ceiling(1.6 * max(c(HomePPDA, AwayPPDA), na.rm = TRUE)))

# ---- substitution windows -----------------------------------------
sub_times <- sort(unique(round(sub_events$expandedMinute)))
sub_bounds <- c()
for (s in sub_times) if (length(sub_bounds) == 0 || s - tail(sub_bounds, 1) > 3) sub_bounds <- c(sub_bounds, s)
sub_bounds <- sub_bounds[sub_bounds > 0 & sub_bounds < FT_minute]
win_breaks <- c(0, sub_bounds, FT_minute + 1)

sub_impact <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(length(win_breaks) - 1), function(w) {
  st <- win_breaks[w]; en <- win_breaks[w + 1]; mins <- max(en - st, 1)
  d  <- ev %>% filter(expandedMinute >= st, expandedMinute < en)
  per10 <- function(v) round(10 * v / mins, 2)
  tilt_h <- sum(d$ft_touch & d$TeamName == Match_Home); tilt_a <- sum(d$ft_touch & d$TeamName == Match_Away)
  made <- sub_events %>% filter(expandedMinute >= st, expandedMinute < st + 4)
  made_txt <- if (w == 1) "Starting XIs" else paste(
    c(if (any(made$TeamName == Match_Home)) paste0(HomeAbbr, ": ", paste(made$Surname[made$TeamName == Match_Home], collapse = ", ")),
      if (any(made$TeamName == Match_Away)) paste0(AwayAbbr, ": ", paste(made$Surname[made$TeamName == Match_Away], collapse = ", "))),
    collapse = " | ")
  tibble(Window = paste0(round(st), "'-", round(min(en, FT_minute)), "'"),
         Mins = round(mins),
         `Subs on` = made_txt,
         Score = score_at(st),
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | xG/10") := per10(sum(d$xg[d$is_shot & d$TeamName == Match_Home])),
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | EPV/10") := per10(sum(d$epv[d$out == 1 & d$TeamName == Match_Home])),
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | Field tilt %") := if (tilt_h + tilt_a > 0) round(100 * tilt_h / (tilt_h + tilt_a)) else NA,
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | PPDA") := ppda_calc(d, Match_Home)[["ppda"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | xG/10") := per10(sum(d$xg[d$is_shot & d$TeamName == Match_Away])),
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | EPV/10") := per10(sum(d$epv[d$out == 1 & d$TeamName == Match_Away])),
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | Field tilt %") := if (tilt_h + tilt_a > 0) round(100 * tilt_a / (tilt_h + tilt_a)) else NA,
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | PPDA") := ppda_calc(d, Match_Away)[["ppda"]])
}))

# ---- goalkeepers --------------------------------------------------
gk_role <- if ("role" %in% names(ev)) coalesce(ev$role %in% c("Keeper", "GK", "Goalkeeper"), FALSE) else rep(FALSE, nrow(ev))
gk_players <- unique(ev$playerId[(gk_role | ev$tv %in% c(11, 41, 52, 54, 59)) & !is.na(ev$playerId)])

gk_ev <- ev %>%
  filter(playerId %in% gk_players) %>%
  mutate(Action = case_when(tv == 10 ~ "Save", tv == 11 ~ "Claim", tv == 41 ~ "Punch",
                            tv == 52 ~ "Pick-up", tv == 54 ~ "Smother", tv == 59 ~ "Sweeper",
                            da | tv %in% c(12, 49) ~ "Other defensive", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Sweeper = tv == 59 | (Action %in% c("Other defensive", "Claim", "Punch") & coalesce(x > 17, FALSE)),
         Distance = ifelse(is_long | coalesce(dist_m >= 32, FALSE), "Long", "Short"))

gk_summary_team <- function(team) {
  g  <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  sf <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == opp_of(team))
  sot <- sf %>% filter(on_target | Goal)
  ga  <- sum(sf$Goal)
  ps  <- g %>% filter(is_pass)
  lg  <- ps %>% filter(Distance == "Long"); st <- ps %>% filter(Distance == "Short")
  tibble(
    Section = c("Keeper", rep("Shot stopping", 6), rep("Area & sweeping", 3), rep("Distribution", 6)),
    Metric = c("Goalkeeper(s)", "Shots on target faced", "xGOT faced", "Goals conceded (excl. OG)",
               "Goals prevented (xGOT - GA)", "Saves", "Save %",
               "Claims", "Punches", "Sweeper actions",
               "Passes", "Pass success %", "Short passes", "Short success %", "Long passes", "Long success %"),
    Value = c(paste(short_name(unique(g$playerId)), collapse = " / "),
              nrow(sot), format(round(sum(sot$xgot), 2), nsmall = 2), ga,
              format(round(sum(sot$xgot) - ga, 2), nsmall = 2),
              sum(g$Action == "Save", na.rm = TRUE), pct_txt(sum(g$Action == "Save", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(sot)),
              sum(g$Action == "Claim" & g$out == 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(g$Action == "Punch", na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(g$Sweeper, na.rm = TRUE),
              nrow(ps), pct_txt(sum(ps$out == 1), nrow(ps)),
              nrow(st), pct_txt(sum(st$out == 1), nrow(st)),
              nrow(lg), pct_txt(sum(lg$out == 1), nrow(lg))) %>% as.character()
  )
}
gk_summary <- gk_summary_team(Match_Home) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Home := Value) %>%
  left_join(gk_summary_team(Match_Away) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Away := Value), by = c("Section", "Metric"))

# ---- shared pitch plot for arrows ---------------------------------
pitch_title <- function(title, subtitle = Match_Fixture) {
  list(labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = My_caption),
       theme_ai(title_size = 9, subtitle_size = 6, legend_position = "bottom"),
       theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_blank(),
             legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
             legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA)))
}
```

```{r}
)
```

## Match Report
```{r}
#| title: Match Report
#| label: match report text

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Auto-generated match report: every sentence is built from the
# tables behind the dashboard, so it updates with each new match.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
f2  <- function(v) format(round(v, 2), nsmall = 2)
pct <- function(a, b) if (b > 0) paste0(round(100 * a / b), "%") else "0%"
n_txt <- function(n, word) paste0(n, " ", word, ifelse(n == 1, "", "s"))

# -- set pieces --
sp_sentence <- function(team) {
  s  <- sp_events %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team)
  co <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Corner"); dc <- co %>% filter(delivery == "Direct corner")
  sh <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team)
  sp <- sh %>% filter(Class == "Set piece")
  paste0("<b>", team, "</b> took ", n_txt(nrow(co), "corner"),
         if (sum(co$short) > 0) paste0(" (", sum(co$short), " short)") else "",
         if (nrow(dc) > 0) paste0(", winning first contact on ", sum(dc$First_Contact == "Won"), " of ", nrow(dc), " direct deliveries") else "",
         ". Set pieces produced ", n_txt(nrow(sp), "shot"), " worth ", f2(sum(sp$xg)), " xG",
         if (sum(sp$Goal) > 0) paste0(" and ", n_txt(sum(sp$Goal), "goal")) else "",
         " (", pct(sum(sp$xg), sum(sh$xg)), " of their xG).")
}

# -- transitions --
tr_sentence <- function(team) {
  rs <- regain_seqs %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team)
  fs <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, Duration <= fast_window)
  paste0("<b>", team, "</b> won the ball in open play ", rs %>% nrow(), " times (",
         sum(rs$start_x >= 66.7, na.rm = TRUE), " in the attacking third) and had ",
         n_txt(nrow(fs), "shot"), " within ", fast_window, " seconds of a regain, worth ", f2(sum(fs$xg)), " xG",
         if (sum(fs$Goal) > 0) paste0(" including ", n_txt(sum(fs$Goal), "goal"),
                                      " (", paste(paste0(fs$Shooter[fs$Goal], " ", fs$Min[fs$Goal]), collapse = ", "), ")") else "",
         ".")
}

# -- defensive shape: biggest quarter-to-quarter change in block height --
shape_change <- function(team) {
  d <- def_shape %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, Game_Quarter != "Injury Time") %>% arrange(Game_Quarter)
  if (nrow(d) < 2) return(NULL)
  ch <- diff(d$`DA height (m)`); i <- which.max(abs(ch))
  tibble(team = team, from_q = as.character(d$Game_Quarter[i]), to_q = as.character(d$Game_Quarter[i + 1]),
         from_h = d$`DA height (m)`[i], to_h = d$`DA height (m)`[i + 1], change = ch[i],
         score = d$`Score at start`[i + 1])
}
sc <- bind_rows(shape_change(Match_Home), shape_change(Match_Away)) %>% arrange(desc(abs(change)))
shape_txt <- if (nrow(sc) > 0) {
  lead <- sc[1, ]; other <- if (nrow(sc) > 1) sc[2, ] else NULL
  paste0("<b>", lead$team, "</b>'s defensive actions ", ifelse(lead$change < 0, "dropped", "pushed up"),
         " from an average of ", lead$from_h, "m to ", lead$to_h, "m from their own goal between the ",
         lead$from_q, " and the ", lead$to_q, " (score ", lead$score, " at the start of the ", lead$to_q, ")",
         if (!is.null(other)) paste0(", while <b>", other$team, "</b> went from ", other$from_h, "m to ", other$to_h,
                                     "m over the ", other$from_q, " to ", other$to_q) else "",
         ". Standard PPDA: ", Match_Home, " ", HomePPDA_Proper, ", ", Match_Away, " ", AwayPPDA_Proper,
         " (lower = more pressing).")
} else ""

# -- passing chains --
seq_passes <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball, !is.na(seq_id)) %>%
  group_by(seq_id, TeamName) %>%
  summarise(passes = sum(is_pass & out == 1), shot = any(is_shot), goal = any(is_shot & tv == 16),
            min = dplyr::first(minute), per = dplyr::first(period), .groups = "drop")
chain_sentence <- function(team) {
  d <- seq_passes %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("")
  long <- d %>% filter(passes >= 10)
  best <- d %>% slice_max(passes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  paste0("<b>", team, "</b> strung together ", n_txt(nrow(long), "move"), " of 10+ completed passes (",
         pct(sum(long$passes), sum(d$passes)), " of their completed passes came in those moves",
         if (nrow(long) > 0) paste0(", ", sum(long$shot), " ended in a shot") else "",
         "). Their longest move was ", best$passes, " passes (", fmt_match_minute(best$min, best$per), ")",
         if (best$goal) " and ended in a goal" else if (best$shot) " and ended in a shot" else "", ".")
}

# -- threat areas: where successful actions added the most EPV --
threat_sentence <- function(team) {
  d <- ev %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, out == 1, !is.na(x), epv != 0) %>%
    mutate(zone = paste0(c(`Def third` = "defensive third", `Mid third` = "middle third",
                           `Att third` = "final third")[third_of(x)], ", ", tolower(as.character(channel_of(y)))))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("")
  z <- d %>% group_by(zone) %>% summarise(epv = sum(epv), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(epv))
  tot <- sum(pmax(z$epv, 0))
  paste0("<b>", team, "</b> generated most threat from the ", z$zone[1], " (", f2(z$epv[1]), " EPV, ",
         pct(z$epv[1], tot), ")", if (nrow(z) > 1) paste0(", followed by the ", z$zone[2], " (", f2(z$epv[2]), ")") else "", ".")
}

# -- pass maps: most-used combination and the most involved player --
pass_links <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball, !is.na(seq_id)) %>%
  mutate(receiver = dplyr::lead(playerId), rec_seq = dplyr::lead(seq_id)) %>%
  filter(is_pass, out == 1, rec_seq == seq_id, receiver != playerId)
passmap_sentence <- function(team) {
  d <- pass_links %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("")
  pair <- d %>% count(playerId, receiver, sort = TRUE) %>% slice(1)
  hub <- bind_rows(d %>% count(p = playerId), d %>% count(p = receiver)) %>%
    group_by(p) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% slice(1)
  paste0("<b>", team, "</b>'s most used combination was ", short_name(pair$playerId), " to ",
         short_name(pair$receiver), " (", pair$n, " completed passes), and ", short_name(hub$p),
         " was the hub of the pass map, involved in ", hub$n, " completed passes.")
}

report <- list(
  Summary = summary_line,
  `Set pieces` = c(sp_sentence(Match_Home), sp_sentence(Match_Away)),
  Transitions = c(tr_sentence(Match_Home), tr_sentence(Match_Away)),
  `Defensive shape` = shape_txt,
  `Passing chains` = c(chain_sentence(Match_Home), chain_sentence(Match_Away)),
  `Threat areas` = c(threat_sentence(Match_Home), threat_sentence(Match_Away)),
  `Pass maps` = c(passmap_sentence(Match_Home), passmap_sentence(Match_Away))
)

htmltools::div(
  style = "background:#FFFFFF;color:#1A1A1A;padding:0.6rem 0.9rem;font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.55;",
  lapply(names(report), function(h) {
    htmltools::div(style = "margin-bottom:0.55rem;",
      htmltools::tags$span(h, style = paste0("font-weight:700;color:", Color_Home, ";")),
      htmltools::tags$ul(style = "margin:0.15rem 0 0 0;padding-left:1.2rem;",
        lapply(report[[h]][nzchar(report[[h]])], function(t) htmltools::tags$li(htmltools::HTML(t)))))
  })
)
```

```{r}
#Load data (opta Data)
#Home team Dashboard data
Homedashboard_data <- plottingData %>%
  filter(TeamName == Match_Home) %>%
  filter(TotalShots == 1) %>%
  filter(!Own_Goals == 1  & TeamName == Match_Home) %>%
  filter(!situation == "NA") %>%
  filter(period != 5) %>%
  mutate(TotalxG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalNPxG = cumsum(NPxG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalxGOT = cumsum(xGOT)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(expandedMinute), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(TotalxG), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = as.numeric(Goal_point_X)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = as.numeric(Goal_point_Y)) %>%
  select(x, y, Goal_point_Y, Goal_point_X, TotalxG, TotalNPxG, TotalxGOT, situation, TeamName, TotalShots, xG, NPxG, xGOT, OTShots, minute, expandedMinute, result = type, player = playerId, period, Game_Period)

#Away dashboard data
#Load data
Awaydashboard_data <- plottingData %>%
  filter(TeamName == Match_Away) %>%
  filter(TotalShots == 1) %>%
  filter(!Own_Goals == 1  & TeamName == Match_Away) %>%
  filter(!situation == "NA") %>%
  filter(period != 5) %>%
  mutate(TotalxG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalNPxG = cumsum(NPxG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalxGOT = cumsum(xGOT)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(expandedMinute), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(TotalxG), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = as.numeric(Goal_point_X)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = as.numeric(Goal_point_Y)) %>%
  select(x, y, Goal_point_Y, Goal_point_X, TotalxG, TotalNPxG, TotalxGOT, situation, TeamName, TotalShots, xG, NPxG, xGOT, OTShots, minute, expandedMinute, result = type, player = playerId, period, Game_Period)

# own goals for the xG line plots: not shots, so they stay out of the shot
# data above, but they get a goal marker on the benefiting team's xG line
og_xg_marks <- function(team, team_data) {
  plottingData %>%
    filter(coalesce(as.numeric(Own_Goals) == 1, FALSE), TeamName != team, period < 5) %>%
    transmute(expandedMinute = as.numeric(expandedMinute),
              Goal_point_X = expandedMinute,
              Goal_point_Y = sapply(expandedMinute, function(m) {
                v <- team_data$TotalxG[as.numeric(team_data$expandedMinute) <= m]
                if (length(v)) max(v) else 0 }),
              result = paste0("OG (", short_name(playerId), ")"))
}
HomeOG_xG_marks <- og_xg_marks(Match_Home, Homedashboard_data)
AwayOG_xG_marks <- og_xg_marks(Match_Away, Awaydashboard_data)

#calculate match actual goals
# actual scoreline (includes own goals, which the shot data filters out)
HomeTotalGoals <- HomeGoals
AwayTotalGoals <- AwayGoals

# Define custom colors
custom_colors <- c(Match_Home = Color_Home, "Match Drawn" = "gray", Match_Away = Color_Away)

#run MC for Match outcomes and Match Score proablity using xG
sim_results <- simulate_match_outcomes(
  home_data = Homedashboard_data,
  away_data = Awaydashboard_data,
  home_xg_var = "xG",
  away_xg_var = "xG",
  actual_home_goals = HomeTotalGoals,
  actual_away_goals = AwayTotalGoals,
  method = "xg"
)

# Calculate probabilities for different outcomes
Away_wins_prob <- (sum(sim_results$prob_matrix[upper.tri(sim_results$prob_matrix)])*100)
Home_wins_prob <- (sum(sim_results$prob_matrix[lower.tri(sim_results$prob_matrix)])*100)
tie_prob <- (sum(diag(sim_results$prob_matrix))*100)

# Create a data frame for Match outcome bar chart
outcome_prob <- data.frame(Outcome = c(Match_Home, "Match Drawn", Match_Away),
                           Probability = c(Home_wins_prob, tie_prob, Away_wins_prob))

outcome_prob <- outcome_prob %>%
  mutate(Probability = round(Probability, 2))

#create data frame for Match score tile plot
long_prob_matrix <- sim_results$long_prob_matrix

#redo factor to numeric the score probablity
long_prob_matrix <- long_prob_matrix %>%
  mutate(Home = as.numeric(as.character(Home)),
         Away = as.numeric(as.character(Away)))

#run MC for Match outcomes and Match Score proablity using xG and xGOT
sim_results_blend <- simulate_match_outcomes(
  home_data = Homedashboard_data,
  away_data = Awaydashboard_data,
  home_xg_var = "xG",
  away_xg_var = "xG",
  home_xgot_var = "xGOT",
  away_xgot_var = "xGOT",
  method = "blend",
  xgot_weight = 0.6
)

# Calculate probabilities for different outcomes
Away_wins_prob_blend <- (sum(sim_results_blend$prob_matrix[upper.tri(sim_results_blend$prob_matrix)])*100)
Home_wins_prob_blend <- (sum(sim_results_blend$prob_matrix[lower.tri(sim_results_blend$prob_matrix)])*100)
tie_prob_blend <- (sum(diag(sim_results_blend$prob_matrix))*100)

# Create a data frame for Match outcome bar chart

                           Probability = c(Home_wins_prob_blend, tie_prob_blend, Away_wins_prob_blend))

outcome_prob_blend <- outcome_prob_blend %>%
  mutate(Probability = round(Probability, 2))

#create data frame for Match score tile plot
long_prob_matrix_blend <- sim_results_blend$long_prob_matrix

#redo factor to numeric the score probablity
long_prob_matrix_blend <- long_prob_matrix_blend %>%
  mutate(Home = as.numeric(as.character(Home)),
         Away = as.numeric(as.character(Away)))

#run MC for Match outcomes and Match Score proablity using min
sim_results_min <- simulate_match_outcomes(
```

```{r}
#| title: Match Summary tables

MatchSummaryTable <- MatchSummaryData %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Team") %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Match Summary - Full Time**"),
    subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture)) %>%
  tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = any_of(c("On Ball Time", "xG", "NPxG", "xGOT", "EPV")), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = any_of(c("Touches")), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = any_of(c("Possession %", "Field Tilt %", "EPV % xG Con.", "EPV % NPxG Con.", "Pass Success %", "Long Ball Rate", "Cross Success %")), decimals = 1, scale_values = FALSE) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Possession", columns = any_of(c("Possession %", "On Ball Time", "Touches", "PKBox Touches", "Field Tilt %"))) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Shots", columns = any_of(c("Total Shots", "OFF Shots", "SoT", "ONT Shots", "6yrd box Shots", "PK Box Shots", "Outside Box Shots", "Blocked Shots", "BCs", "Goals", "xG", "NPxG", "xGOT"))) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Threat", columns = any_of(c("EPV", "EPV % xG Con.", "EPV % NPxG Con."))) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Passes", columns = any_of(c("Attempted Passes", "Successful Passes", "Pass Success %", "Long Passes", "Long Ball Rate", "Crosses", "Cross Success %", "Corners", "Short Corners"))) %>%
  tab_style(locations = cells_column_spanners(), style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16))) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Away_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Away)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = Match_Away)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Home_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Home)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = Match_Home)) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.padding = px(1),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    row_group.background.color = "ivory4",
    stub.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    summary_row.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    table.font.size = 14,
    heading.title.font.size = 16,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 14,
    source_notes.font.size = 8,
    table.width = "100%") %>%
  tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16)))
```

### Match Result {.tabset}
```{r}
#| label: Match Result Probablity All Models
#| title: Match Result Probablity - All Models
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-dpi: 200
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| dev.args: !expr list(bg = "snow")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Doughnut charts of the simulated result probabilities. Segments are
# in team colours (draw in grey); the black arc on the outside marks the
# result that actually happened, and the centre shows its probability.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
outcome_levels <- c(Match_Home, "Match Drawn", Match_Away)
outcome_fill   <- setNames(c(Color_Home, "grey70", Color_Away), outcome_levels)
outcome_text   <- setNames(c(Color_Home_Text, "black", Color_Away_Text), outcome_levels)
actual_outcome <- if (HomeTotalGoals > AwayTotalGoals) Match_Home else if (HomeTotalGoals < AwayTotalGoals) Match_Away else "Match Drawn"
actual_label   <- if (actual_outcome == "Match Drawn") "Draw" else paste(actual_outcome, "win")

donut_data <- function(df, model) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels), Model = model) %>%
    arrange(Outcome) %>%
    mutate(ymax = cumsum(Probability), ymin = ymax - Probability, mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
           Actual = Outcome == actual_outcome,
           text_col = unname(outcome_text[as.character(Outcome)]))
}
plot_outcome_donut <- function(d, title, ncol = 1) {
  # text sizes tuned for the same 4 x 3.6 in panel as the score plots;
  # the 2x2 version uses smaller text so it stays on the plot
  multi    <- ncol > 1
  pct_size <- if (multi) 1.25 else 2.6
  ctr_size <- if (multi) 1.5 else 2.2
  centre <- d %>% filter(Actual) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("Actual result\n", actual_label, "\n", format(round(Probability, 1), nsmall = 1), "%"))
  ggplot(d) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2.8, xmax = 4.2, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Outcome), colour = "snow", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_rect(data = centre, aes(xmin = 4.3, xmax = 4.55, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), fill = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(x = 3.5, y = mid, label = ifelse(Probability >= 4, paste0(round(Probability), "%"), ""),
                  colour = text_col), size = pct_size, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(data = centre, aes(x = 0, y = 0, label = label), size = ctr_size, lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_fill, name = "Black arc = actual result", drop = FALSE) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = ncol) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = if (multi) Match_Fixture else paste0(Match_Fixture, " | 10000 sims"),
         caption = My_caption) +
    theme_ai(title_size = 10, subtitle_size = 8,
             legend_position = if (multi) "bottom" else "right") +
    # blank axes/grid (theme_void dropped the snow background, leaving white
    # bands at the sides of the card)
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = "snow"),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA)) +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = if (multi) 5 else 7),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 5, face = "bold"),
          legend.key.size = unit(if (multi) 0.3 else 0.4, "cm"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))
}

all_models <- bind_rows(donut_data(outcome_prob, "xG only"),
                        donut_data(outcome_prob_blend, "Blended"),
                        donut_data(outcome_prob_max, "Optimistic"),
                        donut_data(outcome_prob_min, "Pessimistic")) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("xG only", "Blended", "Optimistic", "Pessimistic")))
# one row of four so the panel fills the wide card (doughnuts are always round)
plot_outcome_donut(all_models, "Match Outcome Probability (10000 sims)", ncol = 4)
```

```{r}
#data imports
df <- plottingData %>%
  arrange(expandedMinute) %>%
  mutate(
    possession_roll5 = slide_dbl(Home_Possession,
                                 mean,
                                 .before = 4,   
                                 .complete = TRUE),
    Field_tilt_roll5 = slide_dbl(Home_FThird_Possession,
                                 mean,
                                 .before = 4,   
                                 .complete = TRUE)) %>% 
  
  select(expandedMinute, Home_Possession, Away_Possession, TeamName, possession_roll5, Field_tilt_roll5, Home_FThird_Possession, Away_FThird_Possession) %>%   
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    Possession_diff = possession_roll5 - Field_tilt_roll5   # positive = home leading
  )

# 2) Smooth the two lines into 'pred' (loess) and clamp to [0,1]
lo_home <- loess(possession_roll5  ~ expandedMinute, data = df, span = 0.2, na.action = na.exclude)
lo_away <- loess(Field_tilt_roll5  ~ expandedMinute, data = df, span = 0.2, na.action = na.exclude)

pred <- tibble(expandedMinute = sort(unique(df$expandedMinute))) %>%
  mutate(
    home_s = pmax(0, pmin(1, predict(lo_home, newdata = cur_data()))),
    away_s = pmax(0, pmin(1, predict(lo_away, newdata = cur_data())))
  )



#data wrangling 
seg <- pred %>%
  arrange(expandedMinute) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = expandedMinute,
    xmax = lead(expandedMinute),
    home_next = lead(home_s),
    away_next = lead(away_s)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(xmax)) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = pmin(home_s, away_s, home_next, away_next),
    ymax = pmax(home_s, away_s, home_next, away_next),
    leader = ifelse(home_s > away_s, "home", "away")
  )

eps <- 1e-3  # small tolerance around crossings

# seg must already have: expandedMinute, home_s, away_s
rib <- seg %>%
  arrange(expandedMinute) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = pmin(home_s, away_s),
    ymax = pmax(home_s, away_s),
    home_on_top = home_s > away_s + eps,
    away_on_top = away_s > home_s + eps
  )

# Two masked ribbons (no overlap)
rib_home <- rib %>%
  mutate(ymin = ifelse(home_on_top, ymin, NA_real_),
         ymax = ifelse(home_on_top, ymax, NA_real_))

rib_away <- rib %>%
  mutate(ymin = ifelse(away_on_top, ymin, NA_real_),
         ymax = ifelse(away_on_top, ymax, NA_real_))
#plot the ribbons and lines
ggplot() +
  # ribbon when HOME is above
  geom_ribbon(data = rib_home,
              aes(x = expandedMinute, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = Color_Home, alpha = 0.30, color = NA) +
  # ribbon when AWAY is above
  geom_ribbon(data = rib_away,
              aes(x = expandedMinute, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = Color_Away, alpha = 0.30, color = NA) +


  # smoothed lines
  geom_line(data = seg, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = home_s),
            linewidth = 0.5, color = Color_Home) +
  geom_line(data = seg, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = away_s),
            linewidth = 0.5, color = Color_Away) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("home" = Color_Home, "away" = Color_Away),
    name   = "Tertiary",
    labels = c("home" = "Possession (red)", "away" = "Field Tilt (blue)")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),   # show 25% instead of 0.25
    limits = c(0, 1)                        # keep axis from 0% to 100%
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(seg$expandedMinute), 15)) +
  
  labs(
    title    = HomeTertiary_title,
    subtitle = Match_Fixture,
    x        = "Match Time (Mins)",
    y        = "Possession (%)",
    caption  = My_caption
  ) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow"),
    plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
    plot.title = element_markdown(),
    plot.caption = element_markdown(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 2),
    legend.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 2),
  
    
    plot.margin  = margin(28, 20, 28, 20)
  ) +
  # team labels
  annotate("label",
           x = max(pred$expandedMinute) / 2, y = 1,
           label = paste(Match_Away, " Defensive Goal Line"), vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5,
           size = 2, color = Color_Away_Text, fontface = "bold", fill = Color_Away) +
  annotate("label",
           x = max(pred$expandedMinute) / 2, y = 0.05,
           label = paste(Match_Home, " Defensive Goal Line"), vjust = 1, hjust = 0.5,
           size = 2, color = Color_Home_Text, fontface = "bold", fill = Color_Home)
```

```{r}
#| title: Match vs Season Average
#| label: match vs season dumbbell
#| eval: !expr focus_has_baseline
#| include: !expr focus_has_baseline
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-dpi: 200

kpi_for <- c(Goals = "Goals", xG = "xG", xGOT = "xGOT", Shots = "Total Shots",
             `Shots on target` = "SoT", `Big chances` = "BCs", `Possession %` = "Possession %",
             `Field tilt %` = "Field Tilt %", `Box touches` = "PKBox Touches",
             `Pass success %` = "Pass Success %", EPV = "EPV",
             `EPV to xG %` = "EPV % xG Con.")
kpi_against <- c(`Goals against` = "Goals", `xG against` = "xG", `Shots against` = "Total Shots",
                 `EPV against` = "EPV", `EPV to xG % against` = "EPV % xG Con.")
kpi_offball_for <- c(`Poss. control /100 touches` = "Poss Control /100 Touches")
lower_better <- names(kpi_against)
# ball-winning counts come straight from compute_summary (not in the summary tables)
kpi_def <- c(Interceptions = "Interceptions_Total", Recoveries = "Recoverys_Total",
             `Tackles won` = "Tackles_Won", `Aerials won` = "Aerial_Won")
off_ball_kpis <- c(names(kpi_def), names(kpi_offball_for), names(kpi_against))

pull_kpis <- function(df, team_filter, map) {
  df <- df %>% filter(team_filter(Team))
  bind_rows(lapply(names(map), function(k) {
    col <- map[[k]]
    if (!col %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
    tibble(KPI = k, value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])), grp = if ("Fixture" %in% names(df)) df$Fixture else "match")
  }))
}
is_focus <- function(t) t == Focus_Team
is_opp   <- function(t) t != Focus_Team

match_vals <- bind_rows(pull_kpis(MatchSummaryData, is_focus, c(kpi_for, kpi_offball_for)),
                        pull_kpis(MatchSummaryData, is_opp, kpi_against)) %>%
  group_by(KPI) %>% summarise(match = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
season_vals <- bind_rows(pull_kpis(season_games, is_focus, c(kpi_for, kpi_offball_for)),
                         pull_kpis(season_games, function(t) t == "All Oppo", kpi_against)) %>%
  group_by(KPI) %>%
  summarise(season = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), lo = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            hi = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), games = n(), .groups = "drop")

def_long <- function(df) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(kpi_def), function(k)
    if (kpi_def[[k]] %in% names(df)) tibble(KPI = k, value = as.numeric(df[[kpi_def[[k]]]])) else NULL))
}
match_def <- compute_summary(plottingData, group_vars = c("TeamName")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(TeamName == Focus_Team) %>% def_long() %>%
  group_by(KPI) %>% summarise(match = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
season_def <- compute_summary(SeasonData %>% filter(as.character(Match_day) != as.character(MatchDay)),
                              group_vars = c("game_name", "Team_Group")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(Team_Group == Focus_Team) %>% def_long() %>%
  group_by(KPI) %>%
  summarise(season = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), lo = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            hi = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), games = n(), .groups = "drop")
match_vals  <- bind_rows(match_vals, match_def)
season_vals <- bind_rows(season_vals, season_def)

dumbbell <- match_vals %>%
  inner_join(season_vals, by = "KPI") %>%
  mutate(KPI = factor(KPI, levels = c(names(kpi_for), off_ball_kpis)),
         Side = ifelse(KPI %in% off_ball_kpis, "Off the ball", "On the ball"),
         better = ifelse(KPI %in% lower_better, match <= season, match >= season),
         Verdict = ifelse(better, "Better than average", "Worse than average"))
lab <- function(v) ifelse(abs(v) >= 10, format(round(v, 0), nsmall = 0), format(round(v, 2), nsmall = 2))
n_games <- max(dumbbell$games)

# one dumbbell panel per KPI; on-ball KPIs on the left, off-ball on the right
plot_dumbbell <- function(df, heading, legend = "none", caption = NULL) {
  ggplot(df, aes(y = 0)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = lo, xend = hi, yend = 0), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 3, lineend = "round") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = season, xend = match, yend = 0), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(x = season), colour = "grey40", size = 2.6) +
    geom_point(aes(x = match, fill = Verdict), shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(aes(x = season, label = lab(season)), vjust = 2.1, size = 2, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_text(aes(x = match, label = lab(match)), vjust = -1.3, size = 2.1, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Better than average` = col_success, `Worse than average` = col_fail),
                      name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~ KPI, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "left") +
    labs(title = heading, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = caption) +
    theme_ai(title_size = 9, legend_position = legend) +
    theme(strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA))
}
dumbbell <- dumbbell %>% mutate(Verdict = factor(Verdict, levels = c("Better than average", "Worse than average")))
on_df  <- dumbbell %>% filter(Side == "On the ball") %>% droplevels()
off_df <- dumbbell %>% filter(Side == "Off the ball") %>% droplevels()
p_on  <- plot_dumbbell(on_df, "On the ball", legend = "top")
p_off <- plot_dumbbell(off_df, "Off the ball", caption = My_caption)

# draw the two halves side by side; the off-ball half is shorter, so it
# is scaled to keep the panels the same height as the on-ball ones
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.rect(gp = grid::gpar(fill = "snow", col = NA))
grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = grid::grid.layout(2, 2, heights = grid::unit(c(0.09, 0.91), "npc"))))
grid::grid.text(paste0(Focus_Team, " - This Match vs Season Average"),
                x = 0.02, y = 0.68, just = "left",
                vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
                gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
grid::grid.text(paste0(Match_Fixture, " | grey dot = average of ", n_games,
                       " other games, grey bar = season range, coloured dot = this match"),
                x = 0.02, y = 0.22, just = "left",
                vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
                gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7))
print(p_on, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))
off_h <- min(1, (nrow(off_df) + 2.5) / (nrow(on_df) + 2.5))
grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 2))
print(p_off, vp = grid::viewport(y = 1, height = off_h, just = "top"))
grid::popViewport(2)
```


# Pass Maps
```{r}
#| title: data wrangling for pass connection tables
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false

PassConnections <- plottingData 
PassConnections <- PassConnections[complete.cases(PassConnections[, "playerId"]), ]
PassConnections <- PassConnections[complete.cases(PassConnections[, "TeamName"]), ]
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "playerId", new_names = "receiver", len = 1, up = TRUE)
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "TeamName", new_names = "receiver_team", len = 1, up = TRUE)
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "x", new_names = "Endx", len = 1, up = TRUE)
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "y", new_names = "Endy", len = 1, up = TRUE)
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "second", new_names = "End_second", len = 1, up = FALSE)

# number of passes or carries between players
EPVEvents <- PassConnections %>%
  select(Passer = playerId, Receiver = receiver, Passer_Team = TeamName, Receiver_Team = receiver_team, Attempted_Passes, Successful_Passes, UnSuccessful_Passes, BCs, Key_Passes, Prog_Passes, Attempted_Carries, Successful_Carries, UnSuccessful_Carries, Prog_Carries, Final_Third_Carries,EPV, xT, x, y, Endx, Endy, PK_Box_Passes, Final_Third_Passes, Cross_Passes, Long_Passes, expandedMinute)


#EPV events prep for main tables
EPVPassEvents <- EPVEvents %>%
  filter(Attempted_Passes == 1) %>%
  select(Passer_Team, Passer, Receiver, Receiver_Team, 'Successful Passes' = Successful_Passes, UnSuccessful_Passes, 'Long Passes' = Long_Passes, Crosses = Cross_Passes, 'PK Box Passes' = PK_Box_Passes, 'Key Passes' = Key_Passes, 'Prog Passes' = Prog_Passes, 'Final Third Passes' = Final_Third_Passes,  BCs, EPV, xT, 'Game Min' = expandedMinute)

EPVCarrieEvents <- EPVEvents %>%
    filter(Attempted_Carries == 1) %>%
    select(Passer_Team, Passer, Receiver, Receiver_Team, 'Successful Carries' = Successful_Carries, UnSuccessful_Carries, 'Prog Carries' = Prog_Carries, 'Final Third Carries' = Final_Third_Carries,  BCs, EPV, xT, 'Game Min' = expandedMinute)
  

# number of passes between players
# Opta records no intended receiver for an incomplete pass (the next event
# belongs to the opponent), so pair-level "pass success" can't be measured.
# Pairs are therefore built from COMPLETED passes only, and completion % is
# shown at the passer level, alongside each pair's share of the passer's
# completions and of the receiver's receptions.
PassAttempts <- PassConnections %>%
  filter(Attempted_Passes == 1)

PasserTotals <- PassAttempts %>%
  group_by(Passer = playerId, Passer_Team = TeamName) %>%
  summarise(Passer_Attempted = sum(Attempted_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            Passer_Completed = sum(Successful_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Passer_Completion = round(100 * Passer_Completed / Passer_Attempted, 1))

CompletedPasses <- PassAttempts %>%
  filter(Successful_Passes == 1, receiver_team == TeamName, !is.na(receiver)) %>%
  select(Passer = playerId, Receiver = receiver, Passer_Team = TeamName, Receiver_Team = receiver_team,
         BCs, Key_Passes, Prog_Passes, EPV = EPVvalue, PK_Box_Passes, Final_Third_Passes,
         Cross_Passes, Long_Passes, EventTime)

ReceiverTotals <- CompletedPasses %>%
  count(Receiver, Receiver_Team, name = "Receiver_Receptions")

PassConnections <- CompletedPasses %>%
  group_by(Passer, Receiver, Passer_Team, Receiver_Team) %>%
  summarise(Completed = n(),
            Long_Passes = sum(Long_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            Final_Third_Passes = sum(Final_Third_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            PK_Box_Passes = sum(PK_Box_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            Crosses = sum(Cross_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            Key_Passes = sum(Key_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            BCs = sum(BCs, na.rm = TRUE),
            Prog_Passes = sum(Prog_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
            EPV = sum(EPV, na.rm = TRUE),
            Pass_time = mean(EventTime, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(PasserTotals, by = c("Passer", "Passer_Team")) %>%
  left_join(ReceiverTotals, by = c("Receiver", "Receiver_Team")) %>%
  mutate(Share_Passer   = round(100 * Completed / Passer_Completed, 1),
         Share_Receiver = round(100 * Completed / Receiver_Receptions, 1),
         EPV_P_Pass     = round(EPV / Completed, 3)) %>%
  filter(Completed >= 5)

#prep for main tables
PassConnectiondata <- PassConnections %>%
  select(Passer_Team, Passer, Receiver, Receiver_Team, 'Completed Passes' = Completed,
         "% of Passer's Completions" = Share_Passer, "% of Receiver's Receptions" = Share_Receiver,
         'Passer Completion %' = Passer_Completion, 'Long Passes' = Long_Passes,
         'Final Third Passes' = Final_Third_Passes, 'PK Box Passes' = PK_Box_Passes, Crosses,
         'Key Passes' = Key_Passes, 'Prog Passes' = Prog_Passes, EPV, 'EPV / Pass' = EPV_P_Pass,
         'Pass Time' = Pass_time)

```

## Pass Connections Home {.tabset}
```{r}
#| title: Pass Connections by Passer
#| label: Home pass connections tables
#| results: asis

PassConnectionTableHome <- PassConnectiondata %>%
  filter(Receiver_Team == Match_Home, 
         Passer_Team == Match_Home) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Receiver", groupname_col = "Passer") %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(`% of Passer's Completions`, `% of Receiver's Receptions`, `Passer Completion %`),
    scale_values = FALSE,
    decimals = 0
   ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(EPV, `EPV / Pass`), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`Completed Passes`, `Long Passes`, `Final Third Passes`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`Pass Time`), decimals = 2) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(Passer_Team, Receiver_Team)) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md(paste0(Match_Home, " Open Play Passing connections")),
    subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, " | Completed passes only, min 5 per pair. Passer Completion % = all of the passer's attempts")) %>%
  tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.padding = px(1),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    row_group.background.color = Color_Home,
    stub.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    summary_row.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
    table.font.size = 14,
    heading.title.font.size = 16,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 14,
    source_notes.font.size = 8,
    table.width = "100%") %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Home_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Home)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())) %>%
  tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16))) 

PassConnectionTableHome
```
