## Defensive Block {.flow}
### Home
```{r}
#| title: Home Defensive Block by Quarter
#| label: home defensive block
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-dpi: 200

plot_block <- function(team) {
  pts <- shape_data %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, da, Game_Quarter != "Injury Time")
  box <- def_shape %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, Game_Quarter != "Injury Time")
  hull <- block_hull %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, Game_Quarter != "Injury Time")
  block_layer <- if (block_method == "mad" && block_shape == "hull") {
    geom_polygon(data = hull, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = team_col(team), alpha = 0.18,
                 colour = team_col(team), linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  } else {
    geom_rect(data = box, aes(xmin = x10, xmax = x90, ymin = y10, ymax = y90),
              fill = team_col(team), alpha = 0.18, colour = team_col(team), linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  ggplot(pts) +
    pitch_base() +
    block_layer +
    geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y), colour = team_col(team), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(data = box, aes(xintercept = xm), colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_label(data = box, aes(x = 50, y = 104, label = paste0(`DA height (m)`, "m high | score ", `Score at start`)),
               size = 2, label.size = 0, fill = "snow", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ Game_Quarter, nrow = 2) +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " Defensive Block by Quarter"),
                paste0(Match_Fixture, if (block_method == "mad")
                  paste0(" | shaded ", ifelse(block_shape == "hull", "area", "box"), " = defensive actions within ", mad_k, " MAD of the median, dashed line = median height")
                  else " | shaded box = middle 80% of defensive actions, dashed line = average height")) +
    team_strip(team)
}
plot_block(Match_Home)
```

# Pressing Analysis
``` {r}
#| label: pressing data calculations
#| output: none

library(zoo)
library(paletteer)
library(RColorBrewer)

#load in data if needed

PlayerLogos <- MD_lineups

PlayerLogos_home <- PlayerLogos %>%
  filter(Team == Match_Home)

PlayerLogos_away <- PlayerLogos %>%
  filter(Team == Match_Away)

fileNamePress <- paste0("~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Data Sets/AI Pressing/Season ", Season, "/", Match_Fixture, "_AI_Pressing.xlsx")


AIMatchday <- read_excel(fileNamePress)

pressdataAI <- AIMatchday

pressdataAI_home <- pressdataAI %>%
  filter(`Pressing Team` == Match_Home
         #, Confidence == "Low"
         )

pressdataAI_Away <- pressdataAI %>%
  filter(`Pressing Team` == Match_Away
         #, Confidence == "Low"
         )

Cube_Possession <- HomePossession^(1/3)
Cube_Oppo_Possession <- AwayPossession^(1/3)

# Home data calculation  

TouchDataAITable_home <- pressdataAI_home %>%
  group_by(playerId, Position) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total Presses` = sum(Presses, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Pushed Opponent Back` = sum(Pushed_Opponent_Back, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Won Possession` = sum(Won_Possession, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Put Ball Out of Play` = sum(Put_Ball_Out_of_Play, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Direct Possession Win` = sum(Direct_Possession_Win, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Group Press` = sum(Group_Press, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Counter Attack` = sum(Counter_Attack, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Counter Press` = sum(Counter_Press, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Led to Shot` = sum(`Led to Shot`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Led to Goal` = sum(`Led to Goal`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Turnover = sum(Turnover, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Conceded Cross` = sum(Conceeded_Cross, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Conceded Free Kick` = sum(Conceeded_Free_Kick, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Conceded Shot` = sum(Conceeded_Shot, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Failed Press` = sum(Failed_Press, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Successful Presses` = sum(Successful_Presses, na.rm = TRUE),
    `High Value Presses` = sum(`High Value Presses`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    `Solo Press` = `Total Presses` - `Group Press`,
    
    `Total Failed Presses` =
      `Conceded Cross` +
      `Conceded Free Kick` +
      `Conceded Shot` +
      `Failed Press`,
    
    `Total Successful Presses` =
      `Total Presses` - `Total Failed Presses`,
    
    Net =
      `Total Successful Presses` - `Total Failed Presses`,
    
    `Press Efficiency` = round(
      (`Total Successful Presses` / `Total Presses`) * 100,
      1
    ),
    
    `PAdj Presses` = round(
      `Total Presses` *
        first(Cube_Possession) /
        first(Cube_Oppo_Possession),
      1
    ),
    
    Player = first(playerId),
    'Mins Played' = first(minutes_played),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(full_name = Player, Position, 'Mins Played', 'Total Presses', 'PAdj Presses', 'Total Successful Presses', 'Total Failed Presses', Net, 'Press Efficiency', 'Solo Press', 'Group Press', 'Pushed Opponent Back', 'Direct Possession Win', 'Counter Attack', 'Counter Press', 'Won Possession', 'Led to Shot', 'Led to Goal', 'High Value Presses', `Conceded Cross`, `Conceded Shot`, `Conceded Free Kick`, `Failed Press`)

PressTargets_home <- pressdataAI_home %>% 
  select(Player = playerId, Target = `Opponent Name`, Presses, `Successful Presses` = Successful_Presses, `Failed Presses` = Failed_Press, `Led to Goal`, `Led to Shot`, `Won_Possession`, `High Value Presses`) %>% 
  group_by(Player, Target) %>% 
  summarise_all(sum, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  arrange(desc(Presses))

PressTargetTableData_home <- pressdataAI_home %>% 
  distinct(`Game Time`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Target = `Opponent Name`, Presses, Successful_Presses, Conceeded_Cross, Conceeded_Shot, Conceeded_Free_Kick, Failed_Press, Group_Press, `Led to Goal`, `Led to Shot`, `Won_Possession`, `High Value Presses`) %>% 
  mutate("Number Targets" = Presses,
         "Targeted by Groups" = Group_Press,
         "Targetted Possession Win" = `Won_Possession`,
         "Targetted High Value Win" = `High Value Presses`) %>%
  group_by(Target) %>% 
  summarise_all(sum, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(`Target Fails` = (Conceeded_Cross + Conceeded_Free_Kick + Conceeded_Shot + Failed_Press),
         `Target Success` = (`Number Targets` - `Target Fails`),
         `Target High Value Rate` = (`Targetted High Value Win` / `Number Targets`),
         `Target Efficiency` = (`Target Success` / `Number Targets`), 
         `Target Led to Goal or Shot` = (`Led to Goal` + `Led to Shot`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Number Targets`)) %>%
  select(Target, `Number Targets`, `Target Success`, `Target Fails`, `Targeted by Groups`, `Target Led to Goal or Shot`, `Targetted Possession Win`, `Targetted High Value Win`, `Target High Value Rate`, `Target Efficiency`)

PlayerPressPos_home <- pressdataAI_home %>%
  mutate("Shirt" = `Player Number`) %>%
  group_by(playerId) %>%
  mutate(averageX = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
         averageY = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate("Player" = playerId) %>%
  select(Player, Shirt, averageX, averageY) %>%
  distinct(Player, Shirt, averageX,averageY)

PressNetworkData_home <- pressdataAI_home %>%
  mutate("Player" = playerId)

#create summary data and add average positions - need to check this TouchDataAITable_home
PressnetworkSummaryData_home <- TouchDataAITable_home %>%
  mutate("Player" = full_name) %>%
  select(Player, `Press Efficiency`) %>%
  left_join(PlayerPressPos_home, by = c("Player" = "Player"), copy = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(PlayerLogos_home, by = c("Player" = "Player"), copy = TRUE)

  mutate(`Mins Played` = as.numeric(minutes_played),)

  Press_Data_home <- pressdataAI_home %>%
    group_by(minute) %>%
  summarize_if(is.numeric, sum) %>%
    select(minute, Presses)
  
  GoalMin <- plottingData 
  
  GoalMin_Home <- GoalMin %>%
    team_rows_with_og(Match_Home) %>%   # own rows, plus opponent OGs as goals
    mutate(Goal_point = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(minute), NA)) %>%
    mutate(Goal_point = as.numeric(Goal_point)) %>%
    mutate(Goal_point_min = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(minute), NA)) %>%
    select(minute, Goal_point, Goal_point_min)
  
  PAPA_Data_home <- plottingData %>%
 #why is this here only collect pressing for mid and final zone so this removed defensive zone
    filter(x <= 76)
  
  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    select(minute, Home_Passes, Away_Passes, Home_Successful_Passes, Away_Successful_Passes, Home_Possession, Away_Possession) %>%
    group_by(minute) %>%
    summarize(
      Away_Passes = sum(Away_Passes),
      Home_Passes = sum(Home_Passes),
      Away_Successful_Passes = sum(Away_Successful_Passes),
      Home_Successful_Passes = sum(Home_Successful_Passes),
      Home_Possession = mean(Home_Possession),
      Away_Possession = mean(Away_Possession))
  

  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    left_join(Press_Data_home, by = c("minute" = "minute"), copy = TRUE) %>%
      replace_na(list(Presses = 0))

  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    mutate(Cube_Possession = Home_Possession^(1/3),
           Cube_Away_Possession = Away_Possession^(1/3),
           PAPA = (Presses*Cube_Away_Possession)/Cube_Possession,
           OPPP = (Away_Passes/Presses),
           OPPP = round(OPPP,2),
           PAPA = round(PAPA,2)) %>%
    replace_na(list(PAPA = 0)) %>%
    replace_na(list(OPPP = 0)) %>%
    mutate(Rolling_PAPA = rollmean(PAPA, k = 10, fill = NA),
           Rolling_OPPP = rollmean(OPPP, k = 10, fill = NA)) %>%
    replace_na(list(Rolling_PAPA = 0)) %>%
    replace_na(list(Rolling_OPPP = 0)) %>%
    mutate(across(.cols = everything(), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), 0, .x)))
  
  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    mutate(PAPA_percentile_rank = ecdf(PAPA_Data_home$OPPP)(PAPA) * 100,
           OPPP_percentile_rank = ecdf(PAPA_Data_home$OPPP)(OPPP) * 100,
           PAPA_Roll_percentile_rank = ecdf(PAPA_Data_home$Rolling_PAPA)(Rolling_PAPA) * 100,
           OPPP_Roll_percentile_rank = ecdf(PAPA_Data_home$Rolling_OPPP)(Rolling_OPPP) * 100)

  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    mutate(PAPA_Overall_Percentile = (PAPA_percentile_rank + OPPP_percentile_rank)/2,
           PAPA_Overall_Percentile = round(PAPA_Overall_Percentile,2)) %>%
    mutate(PAPA_Overall_Percentile_Roll = (PAPA_Roll_percentile_rank + OPPP_Roll_percentile_rank)/2,
           PAPA_Overall_Percentile_Roll = round(PAPA_Overall_Percentile_Roll, 2)) %>%
    mutate(PAPA_Overall_Roll = rollmean(PAPA_Overall_Percentile, k = 5, fill = NA),
           PAPA_Overall_Roll = round(PAPA_Overall_Roll, 2)) %>%
             replace_na(list(PAPA_Overall_Roll = 0))
 
  PAPA_Data_home <- PAPA_Data_home %>%
    left_join(GoalMin_Home, by = c("minute" = "minute"), copy = TRUE)
  

  PAPAQ <- quantile(PAPA_Data_home$PAPA, probs = c(.1, .2, .3, .4, .5, .6, .7, .8, .9, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  OPPP <- quantile(PAPA_Data_home$OPPP, probs = c(.1, .2, .3, .4, .5, .6, .7, .8, .9, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

  #Prepare plot backgounrd  
  make_gradient <- function(deg = 90, n = 100, cols = blues9) {
    cols <- colorRampPalette(cols)(n + 1)
    rad <- deg / (180 / pi)
    mat <- matrix(
      data = rep(seq(0, 1, length.out = n) * cos(rad), n),
      byrow = TRUE,
      ncol = n
    ) +
      matrix(
        data = rep(seq(0, 1, length.out = n) * sin(rad), n),
        byrow = FALSE,
        ncol = n
      )
    mat <- mat - min(mat)
    mat <- mat / max(mat)
    mat <- 1 + mat * n
    mat <- matrix(data = cols[round(mat)], ncol = n)
    grid::rasterGrob(
      image = mat,
      width = unit(1, "npc"),
      height = unit(1, "npc"), 
      interpolate = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  #set background colours 
  g <- make_gradient(
    deg = 90, n = 100, cols = brewer.pal(9, "RdBu"))
```

## Press Heat Maps {.flow}
### Home {.tabset}
``` {r}
#| label: Home Press Heat Map FT
#| title: Full Time
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200
#| height: 100%

PressHeatMapFT_home <- pressdataAI_home %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  pitch_base(fill = "#E5E5E5", zone_lwd = 0.2, labels = TRUE, label_size = 3) +
  
  #geometrics
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  #set scales
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC, trans = "sqrt") +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC, trans = "sqrt") +
  
  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Press Heat Map - FT"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture,"  \nDirection of play Left to Right, Darker colour = Higher Press"),
       caption =  My_caption) +
  theme_ai(title_size = 8, subtitle_size = 6)

#call plot
```

## Home Pressing Stats
```{r}
#| label: Home Pressing Stats
#| title: Home Pressing Stats
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200

AIPressTable_home <- TouchDataAITable_home %>% 
  gt(rowname_col = "full_name", groupname_col = "Position") %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Summary", columns = c('Total Presses', 'PAdj Presses', 'Total Successful Presses', 'Total Failed Presses', Net, 'Press Efficiency', 'Solo Press', 'Group Press')) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Positive Actions", columns = c('Pushed Opponent Back', 'Direct Possession Win', 'Counter Attack', 'Counter Press', 'Won Possession', 'Led to Shot', 'Led to Goal', `High Value Presses`)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Negative Actions", columns = c(`Conceded Cross`, `Conceded Shot`, `Conceded Free Kick`, `Failed Press`)) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md(paste0(Match_Home, " Individual Player Pressing Stats")),
    subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture)) %>%
    tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
  summary_rows(columns = c(4:23), fns = list("Unit Mean" = ~ mean (., na.rm=TRUE)), fmt = list(~fmt_number(., decimals = 1))) %>%
  summary_rows(groups = TRUE, fns = list("Unit Total" = ~ sum (., na.rm=TRUE)), formatter = fmt_number, decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.padding = px(1),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    row_group.background.color = Color_Home,
    stub.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    summary_row.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    table.font.size = 14,
    heading.title.font.size = 16,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 14,
    source_notes.font.size = 8,
    table.width = "100%") %>%
  tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16))) %>%
  gt_color_rows(c(3:3, 6:7, 9:13, 17:21),palette = ColorScale_Home)

AIPressTable_home

```

## Press Target Plots  {.flow}
### Home
``` {r}
#| title: Home Press Target Treeplot
#| label: Home Press Target Treeplot
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200

group <- PressTargets_home$Player
subgroup <- PressTargets_home$Target
value <- PressTargets_home$Presses

#Canvas
PressTreeMap_home <- PressTargets_home %>%
  #geometrics
  ggplot(aes(area = value, fill = value, subgroup = subgroup,
             label = paste(group, value, sep = "\n"))) +
  geom_treemap() +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(colour = "white", size = 5) +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_text(place = "centre", grow = TRUE,
                             alpha = 0.25, colour = "black",
                             fontface = "italic") +
  geom_treemap_text(colour = "black",
                    place = "centre",
                    size = 13,
                    grow = FALSE) +
  #formatting
  theme_ai(title_size = 8, subtitle_size = 6) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  #scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::Reds 3", -1) + 
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Pressing Targets"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, " Darker color = More Targets \n Number & Name = Pressing Player, \n Large Name = Opposition Pressing Target"),
       caption = My_caption)
```

```{r}
    gt(rowname_col = "Target", groupname_col = "Player") %>%
    #  gt_theme_538() %>%
    cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md("Press Oppo Targeting Details"),
      subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture)) %>%
      tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
    #tab_source_note(md("AI Pressing Data")) %>%
    summary_rows(groups = TRUE, fns = list(Average = ~ mean (., na.rm=TRUE)), formatter = fmt_number, decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
    summary_rows(groups = TRUE, fns = list(Total = ~ sum (., na.rm=TRUE)), formatter = fmt_number, decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
    tab_options(
      heading.padding = px(1),
      heading.align = "left",
      column_labels.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
      row_group.background.color = Color_Away,
      stub.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
      column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
      summary_row.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
      table.font.size = 14,
      heading.title.font.size = 16,
      heading.subtitle.font.size = 14,
      source_notes.font.size = 8,
      table.width = "100%") %>%
    tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16)))
  
  PressTreeTable_Away
```

## Press Network Plots {.flow}
### Home
```{r}
#| label: Home Press Map 1st Sub
#| title: Home Press Map
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200

PressnetworkSummaryData_home <- PressnetworkSummaryData_home %>%
  filter(Mins_Played >= firstSubHome) 

#filter my min
PressNetworkData_home <- PressNetworkData_home %>%
  filter(minute <= firstSubHome)

#plot press direction
PressNetworkPlot_home <- PressNetworkData_home %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  pitch_base(fill = "#E5E5E5", zone_lwd = 0.2, labels = TRUE, label_size = 3) +
  
  #geometrics
  geom_segment(aes(x = averageX, y = averageY, xend = x, yend = y, color = Player, linetype = ifelse(Failed_Press, "solid", "dotted")),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.20, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  
  #plot player average positions
  geom_point(data = PressnetworkSummaryData_home, aes(x = averageX, y = averageY, fill = `Press Efficiency`, color = Player), size = 6, shape = 21, stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = PressnetworkSummaryData_home, aes(x = averageX, y = averageY), fill = "black", size = 3, shape = 21, stroke = 1) +
  
  #plot player names
  geom_text(data = PressnetworkSummaryData_home, aes(x = averageX, y = averageY,  label = Shirt), color = "white", size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ColorScale_Home) +


  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Team Press Directional Map"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture,"  \n Direction of play Left to Right, Darker Red Ring = Higher Press Effeciency \n Dot  = Player Average Press Position, Dotted Arrow = Failed Press"),
       caption = My_caption) +
  theme_ai(title_size = 8, subtitle_size = 6)
```

```{r}
  #Geometrics

  #npXg line

  #xGOT line

  #add ball image for goals

  geom_label_repel(aes(x = Goal_point_X, y = Goal_point_Y, label = paste0(result, " Min:", expandedMinute, "\nxG:", xG)), size = 1.5) +
  # own goals scored for this team
  geom_image(data = HomeOG_xG_marks, inherit.aes = FALSE, mapping = aes(x = Goal_point_X, y = Goal_point_Y, image = "~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Icons/ball2.png"), size = 0.05) +
  geom_label_repel(data = HomeOG_xG_marks, aes(x = Goal_point_X, y = Goal_point_Y, label = paste0(result, " Min:", expandedMinute)), size = 1.5) +
```

## xG Density
### Home {.tabset}
```{r}
#| title: Full Time Shot Density
#| label: Home Shot Density plot
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200
#| height: 100%

# Density Shot Map
#canvas
xGDensityPlot <- Homedashboard_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  pitch_base(labels = TRUE, label_size = 3) +
  #make half pitch
  coord_flip(xlim = c(50, 100),
                   ylim = c(100, 00)) +
  #geometrics
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level), text = paste("xG: ", ..level..)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC, trans = "sqrt") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC, trans = "sqrt") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "xG Level")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "xG Level")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 7)) +
  
  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home," xG Density Areas Full Game"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, "\nDarker Colour + Tighter Lines = Higher xG"),
       fill = "xG Level",
       color = "xG Level",
       caption = My_caption,
       ) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 08),        
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.direction = "horizontal", 
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow"), 
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow"))

xGDensityPlot_I <- ggplotly(xGDensityPlot, tooltip = "text")

xGDensityPlot_I <- xGDensityPlot_I %>%
config(displayModeBar = TRUE, 
       displaylogo = FALSE,
       toImageButtonOptions = list(position = "bottom"),
       modeBarButtonsToRemove = list('lasso2d', 'select2d', 'zoomIn2d', 'zoomOut2d', 'autoScale2d', 'pan2d', 'hoverClosestCartesian', 'hoverCompareCartesian'))
```

```{r}
                   ylim = c(100, 00)) + 
  #geometrics
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level), text = paste("xG: ", ..level..)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  #scale_color_paletteer_c(ColorScale_AwayC) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_AwayC, trans = "sqrt") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_AwayC, trans = "sqrt") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "xG Level")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "xG Level")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 7)) +
  
  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Away," xG Density Areas 1st Half"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, "\nDarker Colour + Tighter Lines = Higher xG"),
       fill = "xG Level",
       color = "xG Level",
       caption = My_caption,
       ) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 08),        
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.direction = "horizontal", 
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow"), 
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow"))

xGDensityPlotAway_I <- ggplotly(xGDensityPlotAway, tooltip = "text")

xGDensityPlotAway_I <- xGDensityPlotAway_I %>%
config(displayModeBar = TRUE, 
       displaylogo = FALSE,
       toImageButtonOptions = list(position = "bottom"),
       modeBarButtonsToRemove = list('lasso2d', 'select2d', 'zoomIn2d', 'zoomOut2d', 'autoScale2d', 'pan2d', 'hoverClosestCartesian', 'hoverCompareCartesian'))

xGDensityPlotAway
```

## xG Bubble

```{r}
#| lable: Home bubble plot
#| title: Home Threat and xG Bubble plot
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-dpi: 200

ShotBubblexG_data <- plottingData 

ShotBubblexG_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>%
  filter(TeamName == Match_Home)

ShotBubblexG_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>%
group_by(expandedMinute, Game_Period) %>%
  summarize(
    Attempted_Passes = sum(Attempted_Passes),
    Touches = sum(Touches),
    OFShots = sum(OFShots),
    OTShots = sum(OTShots),
    Goals = sum(Goals),
    xG = sum(xG),
    EPV = sum(EPV),
    TotalShots = sum(TotalShots),) %>%
  filter(OFShots > 0 | OTShots > 0 | Goals > 0 )

xGBubblePlot_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>% 
  select(Game_Period, expandedMinute, Attempted_Passes, Touches, OFShots, OTShots, Goals, xG, EPV)

xGBubblePlot_data <- xGBubblePlot_data %>%
  group_by(Game_Period) %>%
  mutate(xG = round(xG,2)) %>%
  mutate(EPV = round(EPV,2)) %>%
  summarize(
    Attempted_Passes = sum(Attempted_Passes),
    Touches = sum(Touches),
    OFShots = sum(OFShots),
    OTShots = sum(OTShots),
    Goals = sum(Goals),
    xG = sum(xG),
    EPV = sum(EPV),
    TotalShots = sum(OFShots + OTShots + Goals),
  )  

#set plot size range
sizeRange <- c(2, 10)

# change data to enable shape to be defined 
  xGBubblePlot_data_pivot <- xGBubblePlot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("EPV", "xG"), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Shape = ifelse(Metric == "xG", "Circle", "Diamond"))
  
  #load final data frame for plot
  xGBubble_Plot <- xGBubblePlot_data_pivot %>%
  
  #Canvas      
  ggplot(aes(x = Attempted_Passes, y = TotalShots, size = Value, fill = Value, text = paste(Metric, ": ", Value, "\nTime Period: ", Game_Period))) +
  
  #geometrics  
  geom_point(aes(shape = Metric), colour = "black", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c( "xG" = 21, "EPV" = 23)) +  # Assign different shapes

  #colors
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  
  #Scale and limits
  scale_size(range = sizeRange) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), breaks = seq(0, 60, 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, 1)) +

  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " xG (Circles) & EPV (Diamonds) Creation by Time Period"),
         subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture),
         caption = My_caption,
         x = "Passes",
         y = "Shots") +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10, face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "gray12", size = 08),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 08),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#454545", size = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "#454545", size = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank())

xGBubble_Plot_I  <- ggplotly(xGBubble_Plot, tooltip = "text")

xGBubble_Plot_I <- xGBubble_Plot_I %>%
config(displayModeBar = TRUE, 
       displaylogo = FALSE,
       toImageButtonOptions = list(position = "bottom"),
       modeBarButtonsToRemove = list('lasso2d','select2d',  'zoomIn2d', 'zoomOut2d', 'autoScale2d', 'pan2d', 'hoverClosestCartesian', 'hoverCompareCartesian'))

xGBubble_Plot_I
#xGBubble_Plot
```

## Shot-Creating Sequences
```{r}
#| title: Where Shots Came From
#| label: shot sequence origins
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 200

origin_levels <- c("Open-play regain", "Keeper", "Goal kick", "Throw-in", "Free kick", "Corner", "Kick-off")
seq_origin <- shot_seq %>%
  mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)),
         start_type = factor(coalesce(start_type, "Open-play regain"), levels = origin_levels)) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, start_type, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(xG = sum(xg), Shots = n(), Goals = sum(Goal), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(start_type %in% unique(coalesce(shot_seq$start_type, "Open-play regain")))

ggplot(seq_origin, aes(x = xG, y = start_type, fill = TeamName)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Shots > 0, paste0(Shots, " shots", ifelse(Goals > 0, paste0(", ", Goals, " goals"), "")), "")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  labs(title = "Shot-Creating Sequences - How They Started",
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, " | xG by how the possession sequence began"),
       x = "xG", y = NULL, caption = My_caption) +
  theme_ai(title_size = 10, subtitle_size = 7, axis = TRUE, axis_size = 7, legend_position = "top") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA))
```

```{r}
#| title: Sequence Summary
#| label: shot sequence summary

seq_summary <- shot_seq %>%
  mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))) %>%
  group_by(Team = TeamName) %>%
  summarise(Shots = n(), Goals = sum(Goal), xG = round(sum(xg), 2),
            `Median passes` = median(Passes), `Median duration (s)` = median(Duration),
            `From regains %` = round(100 * mean(start_type == "Open-play regain", na.rm = TRUE)),
            `10+ pass sequences` = sum(Passes >= 10),
            `Under 10s` = sum(Duration < 10), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Team = as.character(Team))

ai_gt(seq_summary %>% mutate(Group = Team), "Shot-Creating Sequences", group = "Group", rowname = "Team") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = "xG", decimals = 2) %>%
  gt_team_groups(seq_summary$Team) %>%
  tab_footnote("A sequence runs from the moment a team gains the ball (or restarts from a dead ball) until the other team touches it.")
```

## Goalkeepers
### Home
```{r}
#| title: Shot Stopping
#| label: home goalkeeper shot stopping
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 200

plot_shot_stopping <- function(team) {
  d <- shot_seq %>%
    filter(TeamName == opp_of(.env$team), on_target | Goal)
  keeper <- paste(short_name(unique(gk_ev$playerId[gk_ev$TeamName == team])), collapse = " / ")
  ggplot(d, aes(x = expandedMinute, y = xgot)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = HT_minute, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    # same style as the regain-to-shot plot: dots in the shooting team's colour,
    # goals shown with the ball image and labelled
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(!Goal), fill = team_col(opp_of(team)), shape = 21,
               colour = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_image(data = d %>% filter(Goal), aes(image = ball_icon), size = 0.045) +
    geom_text_repel(data = d %>% filter(Goal), aes(label = paste0(Shooter, " ", Min)),
                    size = 2.1, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, FT_minute + 2), breaks = seq(0, 135, 15)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    labs(title = paste0(keeper, " (", team, ") - Shots on Target Faced"),
         subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture, " | dots = saved, balls = goals | xGOT faced ", format(round(sum(d$xgot), 2), nsmall = 2),
                           ", conceded ", sum(d$Goal), ", goals prevented ",
                           format(round(sum(d$xgot) - sum(d$Goal), 2), nsmall = 2)),
         x = "Match Time (Mins)", y = "xGOT of shot", caption = My_caption) +
    theme_ai(title_size = 10, subtitle_size = 7, axis = TRUE, axis_size = 7) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3))
}
plot_shot_stopping(Match_Home)
```

```{r}
#| title: Goalkeeper Summary
#| label: home goalkeeper summary table

gk_table <- function(team) {
  gk_summary_team(team) %>%
    ai_gt(paste0(team, " - Goalkeeper"), group = "Section", rowname = "Metric") %>%
    cols_label(Value = team) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(team)), cell_fill(color = team_col(team))),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = "Value")) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(team)), cell_fill(color = team_col(team))),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_footnote("Goals prevented = xGOT faced minus goals conceded (own goals excluded); positive = kept out more than an average keeper would. Long pass = Opta long ball or 32m+. Sweeper actions = keeper-sweeper events plus claims, punches and defensive actions outside the box.")
}
gk_table(Match_Home)
```

## Goalkeeper Maps {.flow}

```{r}
#| title: Distribution
#| label: home keeper distribution
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 200

plot_gk_distribution <- function(team) {
  d <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, is_pass, !is.na(end_x)) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = ifelse(out == 1, "Successful", "Unsuccessful"),
           Restart = ifelse(goal_kick, "Goal kick", "Open play"))
  ggplot(d) +
    pitch_base() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = end_x, yend = end_y, colour = Outcome, linetype = Distance),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, shape = Restart), size = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Successful = col_success, Unsuccessful = col_fail)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Long = "solid", Short = "dashed")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`Goal kick` = 15, `Open play` = 16)) +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " Goalkeeper Distribution"),
                paste0(Match_Fixture, " | ", paste(short_name(unique(d$playerId)), collapse = " / "),
                       " | long ", sum(d$Distance == "Long"), " (", pct_txt(sum(d$Distance == "Long" & d$out == 1), sum(d$Distance == "Long")),
                       " success), short ", sum(d$Distance == "Short"), " (", pct_txt(sum(d$Distance == "Short" & d$out == 1), sum(d$Distance == "Short")), ")"))
}
plot_gk_distribution(Match_Home)
```

```{r}
#| title: Actions

plot_gk_actions <- function(team) {
  d <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, !is.na(Action), !is.na(x))
  ggplot(d) +
    pitch_base() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 17, ymin = 21.1, ymax = 78.9, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, shape = Action), colour = team_col(team), size = 2.4, stroke = 1) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Save = 16, Claim = 17, Punch = 15, `Pick-up` = 1, Smother = 18, Sweeper = 8, `Other defensive` = 4)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50)) +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " Goalkeeper Actions"),
                paste0(Match_Fixture, " | saves, claims, punches, pick-ups and sweeper actions"))
}
plot_gk_actions(Match_Home)
```

# Methodology

<!--
  HOW TO EDIT THIS PAGE
  Each metric sits in its own card. Replace the text marked
  [ADD DEFINITION] with your own wording. Markdown works inside the
  cards (bold, lists, links, LaTeX maths with $...$).
  To add a metric, copy one ::: {.card} ... ::: block.
-->

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Data & conventions"}
**Event data:** Opta (via WhoScored), processed with the Under Pressure pipeline.

**Pitch:** Opta coordinates, 0-100 on both axes; zone lines mark the thirds, the channels and Zone 14 / half-spaces.

**Match minutes:** charts use Opta's continuous `expandedMinute`; scorer minutes on the overview page use the football convention (e.g. 45+2').

[ADD DEFINITION - anything else readers should know about the data]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="xG, NPxG and xGOT"}
**xG:** [ADD DEFINITION]

**NPxG:** xG excluding penalties.

**xGOT (expected goals on target):** [ADD DEFINITION]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Expected Possession Value (EPV)"}
[ADD DEFINITION - what EPV measures and how to read it]

**EPV % xG Conversion:** team xG divided by team EPV, as a percentage - how much of the threat created turned into shot quality.
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Expected Threat (xT)"}
[ADD DEFINITION - grid/model used and how it differs from EPV]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Possession, Field Tilt and Possession Control"}
**Possession %:** share of the two teams' combined touches.

**Field Tilt %:** share of the two teams' combined final-third touches.

**Possession Control:** possession won (interceptions, recoveries, net tackles, net aerials) minus possession lost (miscontrols, dispossessions, failed passes, crosses and dribbles, off-target and blocked shots, offsides).

**Poss Control /100 Touches:** Possession Control divided by touches x 100, so players and teams with different amounts of the ball can be compared. In the player tables it is greyed out for players with fewer than 20 touches (set by `min_touches_pc`).

[ADD DEFINITION - any interpretation notes]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="PPDA and PPDO"}
**PPDA (passes per defensive action):** opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by the team's tackles, interceptions, challenges and fouls committed in that same zone. Lower = more intense pressing. This one definition is used for the overview value box, the PPDA development plots, the PPDA table, the substitution windows and the match report (`ppda_definition <- "standard"`; set it to `"simple"` for the older all-passes / all-defensive-actions version, which is also shown in the PPDA table subtitle).

**PPDO:** [ADD DEFINITION]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Pressing: PAPA and OPPP"}
**PAPA (possession-adjusted pressing actions):** presses scaled by the cube root of opponent possession over own possession, calculated per minute and shown as a rolling percentile.

**OPPP (opponent passes per press):** [ADD DEFINITION]

[ADD DEFINITION - how the PAPA percentile is built]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Press labels"}
- **Group Press:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Counter Press:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Pushed Opponent Back:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Direct Possession Win:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Won Possession:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Turnover:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Counter Attack:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **High Value Press:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Led to Shot / Led to Goal:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Failed Press / Conceded Cross / Conceded Shot / Conceded Free Kick:** [ADD DEFINITION]
- **Press Efficiency:** successful presses as a % of total presses.
- **PAdj Presses:** presses adjusted for possession share.
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Match outcome simulations (Monte Carlo)"}
Each shot is simulated as a goal / no goal event 10,000 times, and the goals are summed per simulation to give scoreline and result probabilities.

- **xG only:** each shot scores with probability = its xG.
- **Blended:** probability = 0.4 x xG + 0.6 x xGOT.
- **Optimistic:** the higher of xG and xGOT for each shot.
- **Pessimistic:** the lower of xG and xGOT for each shot.

Shots with no xGOT value fall back to xG in all three. [ADD DEFINITION - note whether off-target shots carry xGOT = 0 in your data, which makes them count as 0 in the blended and pessimistic versions]

Own goals are not shots, so they are not simulated - the actual score can sit outside the simulated range.

[ADD DEFINITION - how to read the charts]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Time splits, touch areas and pass connections"}
**Game periods:** 15-minute blocks (0-15 ... 76-90, 90+).

**Game quarters:** 1st (1-25), 2nd (26 to the end of the first half), 3rd (start of the second half to 70), 4th (71-99), with everything else (extra time) as Injury Time.

**Touch / press areas:** the area covering activity within 1.5 MAD of the player's median position (about 75% of actions); dot = average position.

**Pass connections:** built from completed passes only (Opta records no intended receiver for an incomplete pass). Line colour on pass networks = the two players' overall completion %, weighted by passes on that link.

[ADD DEFINITION - game state labels, e.g. garbage time]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Possession sequences, set pieces and entries"}
**Sequence:** starts when a team gets the ball (pass, carry, shot, take-on, touch, interception, recovery, won tackle, keeper claim/pick-up) and runs until the other team has it, the period ends or play restarts from a dead ball. Its **start type** is the first event: corner, free kick, throw-in, goal kick, kick-off, keeper, or open-play regain.

**Shot-creating sequence:** the sequence a shot belongs to. Passes = completed and attempted passes in it before the shot; duration = seconds from its first event to the shot.

**Set pieces:** corners, free kicks and throw-ins from the Opta corner/free-kick flags and qualifiers 5, 6 and 107. A **short corner** is the Short_Corners flag or a corner pass under 20m. **First contact** = the team of the next event within 8 seconds (aerial duels go to the winner); none if the ball goes out first. **Set-piece xG** uses the shot's situation where available, otherwise the start type of its sequence.

**Box / final-third entries:** open-play passes and carries starting outside the box (or below the final third) and ending inside it. Channel = where the action started: wings (outer 21.1%), half-spaces, central. A **carry** is the ball moved 5m+ between where a player received it (end of the previous same-team event) and his next on-ball action, within 10 seconds. Taken from the processing pipeline (Carry_Start_X/Y to C_End_point_X/Y); files processed before that fix use the dashboard's own equivalent definition.

[ADD DEFINITION - anything you want to add]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Transitions, defensive shape and PPDA"}
**Open-play regain:** a sequence started by winning the ball in play rather than from a restart or the keeper. **Regain to shot** = seconds from the regain to the shot; the fast-transition window is 15 seconds. Conceded = the opponent's shots after your team lost the ball.

**DA height:** average position of defensive actions in metres from the team's own goal (105m pitch). **Block depth / width:** by default (`block_method <- "mad"`) the span of the median +/- 1.5 MAD (`mad_k`) of defensive-action positions along and across the pitch, drawn as a box (`block_shape <- "hull"` draws the outline of the actions inside instead); the block line is the median. Set `block_method <- "quantile"` for the 10th-90th percentile box with the mean as the line. **On-ball height:** average position of the team's on-ball events.

**PPDA (standard):** opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by your tackles, interceptions, challenges and fouls in that same zone (your attacking 60%). Lower = more intense pressing. The older dashboard PPDA (all passes / all defensive actions) is shown in the table subtitle for comparison.

[ADD DEFINITION]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Substitution impact and season baseline"}
**Substitution windows:** the match split at each substitution (subs within 3 minutes are grouped). xG and EPV are per 10 minutes so windows of different length compare; field tilt and PPDA are calculated within the window.

**Match vs season:** this match against the average of the focus team's other games in the season database (grey bar = range). Blue = better than average, red = worse; for goals, xG, shots, EPV and EPV to xG % against, lower is better. Off-ball side also shows interceptions, recoveries, tackles won and aerials won.

[ADD DEFINITION]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Goalkeepers"}
**Goals prevented:** xGOT of shots on target faced minus goals conceded (own goals excluded). Positive = the keeper kept out more than an average keeper would.

**Distribution:** keeper passes; long = Opta long ball or 32m+. **Sweeper actions:** Opta keeper-sweeper events plus claims, punches and defensive actions outside the penalty area.

[ADD DEFINITION]
:::
